data.name: Number Clear - Match Master
data.description_full:
Game Introduction
✨ Looking for a way to unwind while keeping your mind sharp? Number Clear is the perfect number logic game for you. It features simple, intuitive rules, yet every elimination move is packed with strategic fun.
☕ Whether you’re killing time during your commute or seeking a peaceful space to think after a busy day, Number Clear delivers the purest, most refreshing puzzle experience. Challenge yourself, beat your high score, and enjoy the ultimate sense of relief as numbers vanish from the board one by one!
How to Play
🎯 Objective: Clear all number tiles from the board and aim for a perfect full clear!
🔢 Matching: Find pairs of identical numbers (e.g., 5 and 5) or numbers that add up to 10 (e.g., 3 and 7).
⚡ Elimination: Connect two numbers horizontally, vertically, or diagonally as long as there are no obstacles between them.
➕ Progression: When no more moves are available, tap the button at the bottom to add extra rows of remaining numbers and use your wits to find new opportunities in the number grid.
Game Features
🚀 Epic Power-Ups: Stuck on a puzzle? Use the Sledgehammer to break a single obstacle, or activate the Logic Tornado to reshuffle the board and unlock brand-new possibilities.
🎨 Minimalist Design: Free from clutter. A clean UI paired with soothing sound effects helps you focus purely on logic and slip quickly into a deep “flow state.”
🏆 Daily Challenges: Fresh, unique puzzles every day. Complete objectives to collect exclusive trophies and make your mark on the global leaderboard.
📡 Play Offline: Fully supports offline mode. Enjoy a quick mental workout anytime, whether on the subway or a plane.
🧘 Stress-Free Experience: No time limits, no forced countdowns — solve puzzles at your own pace and savor the fun.
Pro Player Winning Strategies
💡 Think Globally: Don’t just focus on adjacent numbers! Watch the connections between the end of one row and the start of the next — high-scoring matches often hide there.
💡 Priority Rule: Prioritize combinations that block pathways to free up space for large-scale eliminations later.
💡 Item Management: Earn coins through chain eliminations and use power-ups strategically in key levels to maintain your win streak.
🌈 If you love Sudoku, crossword puzzles, 2048, or number merge games, Number Clear is the perfect choice for you!
🔥 Ready to clear the board? Download Number Clear now and start your number-matching journey — every elimination brings a rush of accomplishment!

Water Color Match is a fun and satisfying color-matching puzzle game that’s easy to play but hard to master. Choose the right bottle, collect the correct color, and complete the level step by step.

How to Play
Colorful liquid flows from the tubes at the top, and each tube contains different layers of colors.
At the bottom, you’ll find color bottles, and each bottle can collect only one color.

Your goal is simple:
Pick a bottle
Place it into the middle slot
Let the liquid flow into it
Match the correct color to collect it
Fill the progress bar and clear the level
As you progress, more colors, more layers, and more challenges will appear!

﻿
Get ready for a fresh and colorful puzzle experience! Blast Flow: Pixel Break combines strategic shooting with satisfying color-matching. Gameplay
Step into a vibrant world where every level is a gorgeous pixel art picture waiting to be uncovered. Below the image, you’ll see a row of cannons in different colors – red, blue, green, yellow, and more. 🎨
TAP a cannon to send it onto the battlefield.
SHOOT only at tiles that match its color – each hit eliminates that tile.
PLAN your moves: you can only use each cannon’s shots wisely, and you may need to switch between cannons to clear all colors.
CLEAR every single tile to complete the level and earn coins. 💰
﻿
As you progress, pixel art grids become larger and more complex, challenging your speed, accuracy, and strategy. The satisfying “pop” of each eliminated tile and the gradual reveal of beautiful artwork make every level a joy to play.
﻿
Ready to Clear the Canvas? 🎨
Download Blast Flow: Pixel Break now and start blasting your way through beautiful pixel art puzzles. Can you uncover every masterpiece? 👇﻿

絶望の底に眠るのは、果たして希望かそれとも―。

はせPを筆頭としたDMM GAMESデザイナーを中心に発足したクリエイティブチーム くまさん。

"Triệu hồi Pet yêu, sẵn sàng nghênh chiến!"

Giương cao cung tên, trấn giữ bờ thành vững chắc! Hãy cùng các chiến hữu đập tan các đợt càn quét dồn dập của lũ quái vật, quyết tâm bảo vệ đến cùng mảnh đất quê hương.

Hành trình vạn dặm sẽ không hề cô đơn khi bạn liên tục gặp gỡ những người bạn mới. Mỗi khi giải phóng một vương quốc bị lãng quên, bạn sẽ có cơ hội chiêu mộ vị Công chúa của vùng đất đó vào đội hình mạo hiểm.

data.name: Город грехов: Путь босса
data.description_full:
Добро пожаловать в Город грехов: Путь босса!

Здесь власть не дают просто так. Её забирают силой, хитростью и верными людьми. Улицы полны денег, предательства и опасных сделок, а каждый район ждёт того, кто сможет подчинить его себе.

Начните путь с самых низов и станьте боссом криминальной империи. Нанимайте людей вне закона, головорезов, карателей и главарей, собирайте сильный отряд, усиливайте персонажей, забирайте ресурсы и расширяйте своё влияние. В этом городе вы либо правите, либо становитесь чьей-то добычей.

[Соберите свою банду]
Нанимайте мафиози, уличных бойцов, гонщиков, байкеров и подпольных боссов со всего Города грехов. У каждого персонажа своя роль, стиль боя и набор навыков. Комбинируйте урон, защиту, контроль и поддержку, чтобы собрать отряд, который сможет разнести любого противника.

[Сражайтесь без лишней рутины]
Автобой берёт грязную работу на себя. Развивайте персонажей, подбирайте состав команды, усиливайте экипировку и грамотно распределяйте ресурсы, а ваша банда сама разберётся с теми, кто встанет у неё на пути. Уличные стычки, войны за территорию и ежедневные подземелья станут проще и быстрее.

[Забирайте добычу каждый день]
Улицы щедры к тем, кто не боится драки. Проходите ежедневные испытания, побеждайте противников и получайте ресурсы для прокачки команды. Каждая победа усиливает вашу банду, расширяет влияние и приближает вас к вершине криминального мира.

[Постройте преступную империю]
Казино, ночные клубы, подпольный бизнес и грязные деньги: всё это может работать на вас. Развивайте свою организацию, объединяйтесь с другими игроками, укрепляйте синдикат и превращайте уличную банду в настоящую мафиозную империю.

[Живите как настоящий босс]
Дорогие машины, роскошные особняки, горы налички, эффектные спутницы и власть над городом. Наслаждайтесь жизнью на вершине, но помните: чем выше вы поднимаетесь, тем больше желающих сбросить вас вниз.

[Пройдите путь власти и предательства]

data.name: イナズマイレブン クロス
data.description_full:
いつでもどこでも　サッカーやろうぜ！

■『イナズマイレブン クロス』とは 

レベルファイブが贈る「イナズマイレブン」シリーズの新作がスマートフォンに登場！
新たな主人公が繰り広げるオリジナルストーリー！
スキマ時間でいつでも、どこでも遊べる超次元サッカー育成シミュレーションゲーム。
自分だけのドリームチームを育成し、試合に挑もう！

▼あらすじ

日本代表イナズマジャパンは、大型クルーズ船『イナズマビッグフェリー』に乗り、
全世界が注目する少年サッカーの祭典
『フットボールフロンティア・インターナショナル（ＦＦＩ）』を勝ち進んでいた。
しかし、大会中に監督が突然の退任を発表する。
次の監督に指名されたのは、チームの補佐をしていた主人公・汐沢(しおさわ) 陽(よう)だった。
いきなりの監督任命に戸惑いながらも、陽は戦術分析能力を活かし、
キャプテンの円堂守や選手たちと力を合わせて、世界の頂点に立つ。

ところが、突如発生した謎の地震で意識を失い、
目覚めた時には、円堂たちの記憶から陽の存在だけが消えていた。
さらに、仲間だったエースストライカー豪炎寺修也と、ゲームメイカー鬼道有人が
帝国学園の姿で敵として現れ、冷たい視線で勝負を挑んでくるのだった。

記憶の消失、改変された関係、変わってしまった世界──
すべての真相を求め、陽は未知なる未来へと進み始める。


▼スキマ時間で手軽に遊べる！戦術重視のコマンドバトル

試合はコマンド選択のみの簡単操作！
さらに完全オートでの試合進行も可能なため、アクションが苦手な方や移動中のスキマ時間でも、手軽にゲームを楽しめます。
選手を鍛え、チームに編成することで、監督としてオリジナルチームを育成。
あなたの采配が試合の勝敗を分ける、奥深い戦略性を体感しよう！

▼こんな人にオススメ！
・「イナズマイレブン」シリーズが好き
・超次元サッカーを楽しみたい
・育成シミュレーションゲームが好き
・自分だけの最強チームを作りたい
・スキマ時間に手軽にゲームを遊びたい
・戦術や采配で勝負するゲームが好き
・熱いスポーツストーリーが好き

■公式X

https://x.com/inazuma_cross

■公式サイト

https://www.inazuma-cross.jp/

■動作環境

対応OS： Android OS 10以降、システムメモリ3GB以上の端末

※必要動作環境を満たしていても、ご利用状況や機種特有の要因により、アプリが正常に動作しない場合もございます。

アプリ本体：無料

data.name: One Single Line
data.description_full:
The premise of the game is elegantly simple, yet notoriously difficult to master.
* **The Goal:** You are presented with a pattern or shape made of dots (vertices) connected by faint lines (edges). Your objective is to draw a continuous line that fills in the entire shape.
* **The Rules:**
1. You must connect all the dots with a single, continuous line.
2. You **cannot lift your finger** from the screen once you start.
3. You **cannot draw over the same line twice**. (However, you *are* allowed to pass through the same dot multiple times).
data.description_short: Connect all dots with one continuous line without retracing.

data.name: CrisisX
data.description_full:
A deadly mysterious virus outbreak wiped out most of the population within a few days, and the unknown infection continues to spread. People fled in chaos into the streets, only to realize that their homes had transformed into a post-apocalyptic wasteland, with toxic mutants and zombies roaming the city. Infrastructure is destroyed, and society and civilization have completely collapsed. Families were separated when fleeing into the wilderness.
Now, in this devastating doomsday, you are on your own! "SURVIVE" is the only thing that matters. How much longer can you make it out there?
CrisisX MAX. Your ultimate survival experience.

▶ The world is yours to discover! ◀
Embark on your unknown adventure by creating a realistic self-avatar and exploring every inch of a unique, wide-open world with one of the largest maps ever developed. Raid cities, bunkers, and other locations teeming with terrifying walking dead, or explore freezing cold forests in the highlands. The game mechanics restore realistic geographic and climate conditions in North America, enabling you to experience different environments, landscapes, weather, and time zones. Confront numerous unexpected and serious tasks in a life after the end of the world, and build yourself a last shelter in this fallen continent!

▶ New order & rules must be established! ◀
Survival of the fittest! Test your survival skills by finding food and water, and collecting essential but rare materials left from the civilized world. Scavenge resources through activities like cutting trees, mining, hunting, gathering, and fishing to gain enough leverage for surviving the last days and perhaps establishing yourself as the most powerful among the last survivors. After all, only the strongest will endure in the light of day!

▶ Knives out, fight or fight! ◀
Exterminate crowds of mutated zombies and shoot down threatening monsters of all kinds. Each infected individual has a different appearance and attacking pattern depending on its mutation routes. As the last survivor, observe and employ a wise strategy to eliminate and escape the state of decay!
Your most formidable enemies are other surviving human players! Do not blindly venture into the dead; instead, grip your weapon tightly, be vigilant, and keep your eyes open for other survivalists passing by, whether engaging in a 1vs1 battle or an alliance battle. The distinction between a loyal friend and a dangerous intruder is often a fine line.

▶ Together, we thrive! ◀
Gain a foothold first by constructing yourself a shelter and exploiting resources through activities like taming horses, building, planting, and breeding. Ally with other survivors, restore a community, and expand in this zombie apocalypse. Fight side by side with your fellow survivors to resist enemy attacks. Only together can we survive in the last days on Earth!

▶ Uncover the mystery behind the end of the world! ◀
On this action packed journey of survival, you’ll be facing different tasks, puzzles and riddles. Solve them to expose the truth of the shattered world and save the dying light of the civilization. Perhaps the destruction of the fallen humanity was not an accident! You may also find more clues to trace your family’s whereabouts!
CRISIS X is YOUR LAST CHANCE OF SURVIVAL!

PLEASE NOTE
Network connection is required.
CrisisX is free to download and play. Some in-app items can also be purchased for real money. In-app purchases can be disabled through your device’s settings.

data.name: DraftCipher
data.description_full:
DraftCipher is a logic puzzle game built around abstract symbol analysis. Each round presents a set of six symbols, and your task is to identify the one that breaks the hidden rule.

Study shape, fill, edge details, and rotation to compare the symbols. Tap a symbol, confirm your choice, and use the feedback to refine your reasoning. Wrong choices reveal helpful hints, and the rule becomes visible after repeated mistakes.

Progress through levels to unlock more rule patterns and expand the rule book. You can also start a daily challenge, track personal records, and review your best streaks, solved games, mistakes, and fastest clear time.

The experience is designed for short focused sessions and works well when you want a calm, thoughtful puzzle flow with clear feedback and local progress saving.

data.name: Lucky Arrow Out
data.description_full:
Welcome to Lucky Arrow Out — a clever puzzle game where every arrow knows where it wants to go.

Your task is simple: look at each arrow, then swipe or tap to release it in the direction it's pointing. Once freed, the arrow will fly straight off the board. But here's the catch — arrows cannot crash into each other. If two arrows collide, you lose one of your three lives.

Plan your release order carefully. Sometimes you need to clear a path. Other times, you must wait for the perfect moment. One wrong move, and the board becomes a tangled mess.

With clean visuals, satisfying sound effects, and gradually tricky levels, Lucky Arrow Out is perfect for quick thinking and calm focus. No rush. No timers. Just arrows, logic, and a gentle challenge.

Can you clear every level without a single crash? Download Lucky Arrow Out and find out. 🏹✨

Pick up a flying broom and go. Free flight over the castle at sunset. Broom racing tournaments against rivals. Custom brooms with real stats – speed, control, handling. The faster the broom, the harder the landings.

YOUR WAND, YOUR STYLE
Craft a wand from rare materials. Tune its stats – some wands are made for power, some for precision. Style your character. Find robes that fit who you want to be.

MAGICAL CREATURES IN THE WILD

Your magic adventure starts now.

● Clear all arrows to complete the level and achieve a perfect escape 🏆

● Thousands of handcrafted levels with increasing complexity and challenge 🧩
● Clean, minimalist design – no clutter, just pure puzzle gameplay 🌿
● Smooth tap controls with satisfying visual and audio feedback 🔊
● Offline-friendly – play anywhere, no Wi-Fi or internet required ✈️
● Helpful hint system for when the maze feels too tangled 💡
● Color mode support for comfortable extended play sessions 🎨

Why You'll Love It: ❤️

● Simple rules, deep strategy ♟️
● A relaxing way to train your brain 🧠
● Logic and spatial thinking training disguised as fun 🎮
● Perfect for short breaks or longer focused sessions ⏱️
● ADHD-friendly design: clear goals, no distractions, instant satisfaction 🎯
● Offline anytime, anywhere – no pressure, no distractions interrupting your flow ✈️

Can you guide every arrow to freedom – or will they collide?

Download and start playing now! Plan smart, clear the board, and let every arrow find its way out! 🏹

data.name: Arrow Lock
data.description_full:
Welcome to ArrowLock: Color Burst – the most vibrant, playful, and brain-teasing puzzle adventure designed for kids, families, and casual gamers of all ages!

Embark on a magical journey through starry skies and fairytale landscapes as you solve cute arrow grids, launch colorful paths, and burst matching lock bubbles! ArrowLock combines spatial logic, playful physics, and charming cartoon graphics into a delightful game that is easy to learn but offers hours of engaging fun.

🎯 THE ULTIMATE PUZZLE GAMEPLAY
In ArrowLock, the goal is simple: clear the grid to unlock the fun! The screen is split into two exciting zones:
• The Bottom Grid: A maze of colorful, interconnected C-shaped and line-shaped cartoon arrows that block each other's path.
• The Top Bouncing Zone: A matching grid filled with colorful lock bubbles that must be popped!

HOW TO PLAY:
1. Tap to Untangle: Find an arrow that has a clear path forward and tap it!
2. Launch & Fly: Watch the arrow smoothly slide out of the grid and fly into the bouncing zone.
3. Burst the Locks: The launched arrow will reflect and bounce off the walls, popping every lock bubble that matches its color!
4. Clear the Board: Pop all the locks to complete the level, unlock new areas, and collect shiny coins!

✨ A MAGICAL EXPERIENCE FOR KIDS & FAMILIES
• Whimsical Fairy-Tale Theme: Play over a beautiful hand-crafted backdrop featuring a cozy cartoon village, bridges, castles, clouds, and starry nights designed to inspire children’s imaginations.
• Gorgeous Glossy 3D Art: Clean vector designs, bright juicy pastel palettes (vibrant oranges, yellows, blues, and greens), and bubbly pop animations that look premium and satisfying on every screen.
• Play & Learn: A fantastic logic game that boosts kids' spatial reasoning, hand-eye coordination, and strategic problem-solving skills in a friendly, stress-free environment.
• Cozy & Relaxing: No strict timers, no high pressure, and no stressful penalties. Play at your own pace whenever and wherever you want!

🚀 DISCOVER AMAZING POWER-UPS & FEATURES
• Epic Special Skills: Stuck on a tricky level? Unleash the "Color Bomb" to burst multiple locks instantly, or trigger the "Snake Rush" for a fast and satisfying cleanup!
• Key & Lock Mechanics: Discover special locked regions on the grid. Find the key on the lock board, pop it, and release the locked arrows to solve the ultimate maze!
• Infinite Levels: Hundreds of unique puzzle configurations that grow gradually in complexity to keep your brain active and entertained.
• Complete Rebranding & Quality Assurance: Enjoy high-performance gameplay, highly responsive touch controls, and smooth cartoon animations built with maximum care.

Are you ready to untangle the colorful arrows, explore the magical castle village, and pop all the locking bubbles?

Download ArrowLock: Color Burst today and let the playful popping adventure begin!

data.name: Oasis Match - 3 Tiles puzzle
data.description_full:
Oasis Match - 3 Tiles puzzle invites you to a serene world where traditional tile matching meets the breathtaking beauty of real-world natural landscapes. This experience is thoughtfully designed for players who value a quiet, focused environment and a visual escape into nature. Whether you are a seasoned enthusiast or seeking a peaceful retreat, you will find a respectful and calming journey here.

Respectful Design for Senior Players 👵
Large Tiles - The game features large, high-contrast mahjong tiles that are easy to identify. This eye-friendly approach ensures you can play for extended periods while maintaining visual comfort.
Nature-Inspired Layout - Our clean interface is designed to complement our stunning natural backgrounds. By focusing on an organized layout, we provide a strain-free experience that lets you concentrate on the joy of the puzzle.
No Pressure - There are no countdown timers or high-pressure mechanics. You are free to think, plan, and move at your own speed in this gentle zen environment.

Daily Brain Training and Mental Wellness 🧠
Daily Mental Stimulation - Solving these tile matching puzzles encourages pattern recognition, memory retention, and strategic thinking. It serves as an excellent daily exercise for the mind.
Balanced Challenge - The difficulty curve is carefully designed to provide a sense of achievement and progress without becoming overwhelming.
Focus and Clarity - Taking a few moments for a mahjong session each day helps maintain mental sharpness and provides a satisfying sense of accomplishment.

A Pure and Reliable Experience 🌿
Play Offline Anywhere - No internet connection is required to access the full game. You can enjoy your journey during your quiet hours at home or while traveling without worrying about data or WiFi.
Real Natural Scenery - Every level features vibrant, high-quality photography of real nature. From tranquil forests to majestic mountains, the background shifts to keep your experience fresh and meditative. Straightforward Mechanics - This is a pure triple match experience. We focus on the core mechanics of the game, providing a stable and dependable app for your leisure time.

How to Play 🎮
Match Three - Tap three identical mahjong tiles to move them to the collection bar and clear them from the board.
Complete the Puzzle - Successfully remove all tiles from the screen to reveal the full beauty of the landscape and advance to the next level.
Strategic Slots - Manage your collection bar wisely to ensure you always have space for your next move as you work toward clearing the board.

Find your peace of mind and rediscover the simple joy of tile matching with Oasis Match - 3 Tiles puzzle!

data.description_full:
Quyết định phê duyệt nội dung kịch bản trò chơi điện tử trên mạng G1: Số 223/QĐ-PTTH&TTĐT ngày 05/05/2026

**The Cozy Floirst: Vườn Hoa Hạnh Phúc – Khu Vườn Hoa Thư Giãn Của Riêng Bạn

Bước vào thế giới hoa đầy màu sắc của Vườn Hoa Hạnh Phúc – nơi bạn có thể tự tay chăm sóc khu vườn mơ ước và điều hành cửa hàng hoa xinh xắn của riêng mình!
Tận hưởng lối chơi nhẹ nhàng kết hợp giữa quản lý vườn hoa và vận hành cửa hàng, mang đến trải nghiệm thư giãn nhưng vẫn đầy thú vị mỗi ngày dù bạn ngại giao tiếp!

**Thiết Kế Khu Vườn Trong Mơ
Khám phá nhiều loài hoa đa dạng như cúc, linh lan, tulip và nhiều giống hoa đặc biệt khác. Trang trí khu vườn theo phong cách riêng và tạo nên không gian ngập tràn sắc hoa của bạn.

**Quản Lý Cửa Hàng Hoa
Thu hoạch hoa, sắp xếp đơn hàng và phát triển cửa hàng hoa ngày càng nhộn nhịp. Mỗi ngày đều có những nhiệm vụ và bất ngờ thú vị đang chờ bạn khám phá.

**Ghé Thăm Vườn Hoa Của Mọi Người
Tham quan khu vườn, lén trộm của người chơi khác, giao lưu và chia sẻ ý tưởng trang trí độc đáo. Kết nối cùng cộng đồng yêu thích hoa và tận hưởng không gian chơi game ấm áp, dễ chịu.

**Thu Thập & Mở Khóa Hoa Hiếm
Sưu tập hạt giống đặc biệt, chăm sóc để mở khóa những giống hoa rực rỡ và hoàn thiện bộ sưu tập khu vườn của bạn.

***Chơi Game & Nhận Hoa Thật!
Đây là bất ngờ lớn nhất: Người chơi may mắn có thể đổi nhận hoa thật – và bạn có thể là người tiếp theo! Sự lãng mạn từ game nở rộ ngoài đời thực, đầy đủ sự trang trọng!
Bạn có thể quản lý khu vườn mơ ước, tận hưởng tương tác trộm hoa, kết giao bạn bè cùng chí hướng, thậm chí còn nhận hoa thật – ai mà không thích Vườn Hoa Hạnh Phúc chứ?

Cùng ""Vườn Hoa Hạnh Phúc"" bắt đầu hành trình xây dựng khu vườn hoa thư giãn dành riêng cho bạn hôm nay!

data.name: Alphabet Merge!
data.description_full:
Alphabet Merge! - The Ultimate Real-Time Word Puzzle
Get ready to test your reflexes and expand your vocabulary! Alphabet Merge! is a highly engaging, strategic word-building puzzle game where fast-paced arcade action meets rigorous brain training.

Manage a continuous cascade of falling alphabet blocks within a 6x10 grid. As letters plummet from the top, you must think fast and make rapid decisions to prevent the board from overflowing. Do you have what it takes to survive the drop?

🎮 How to Play
Physically interact with the grid by sliding your finger across adjacent or diagonal letters to connect sequences. Build meaningful words to clear the board, score points, and stay alive!

✨ Key Features
👉 Intuitive Swipe Controls
Freely connect letters in any direction—up, down, left, right, and diagonally! Just swipe to construct your words.

🧠 Real-Time Dictionary Validation
Powered by a sophisticated built-in English dictionary backend, every sequence you form is evaluated instantly. Experience seamless, lag-free gameplay as the game confirms your words on the fly.

💥 Satisfying Merge Mechanics
When a valid word is formed, the connected letter blocks gracefully merge and clear out of the grid, rewarding you with a satisfying visual effect and a boost to your score.

🌪️ Gravity-Driven Combos
Clearing words is just the beginning! Once blocks disappear, suspended letters physically drop down due to gravity. This dynamically reshapes the board, creating thrilling chain reactions and massive combo opportunities!

🏆 Reflexes Meet Strategy
It's not just about knowing words; it's about finding them under pressure. Perfect your quick decision-making skills and push your vocabulary to the absolute limit.

Futuristic Visuals: Detailed road markings, glowing neon borders, sci-fi parks, and a unique mix of terrestrial and space vehicles. See every obstacle with total clarity.
Dynamic Flow: Heavy transport and galactic starships move unpredictably. Learn to "read" the road and adapt to changing traffic patterns in real-time.

data.name: Đạo Sĩ Bắt Trương Phi
data.description_full:
Đạo Sĩ Bắt Trương Phi: Vua Bùa Chú #1 Việt Nam

Một cõi giới ngập tràn tà khí dần hé mở, nơi quỷ thần lẩn khuất trong từng khoảng không và những pháp trận bùng sáng giữa màn sương đặc quánh. Bạn nhập vai đạo sĩ bước đi trên lằn ranh âm - dương, họa phù chú, dựng đàn tế, trấn phong những linh hồn cuồng loạn đang thức tỉnh. Từ ánh linh hỏa bốc lên nơi pháp đàn đến khoảnh khắc phong ấn nghẹt thở, mọi trải nghiệm đều phủ màu ma mị và căng thẳng tột độ. Ở đó, bạn nắm giữ quyền năng thao túng âm dương, khắc chế tà lực và xoay chuyển thế trận bằng chính đạo thuật của mình trong một thế giới quỷ thần đầy sống động.

- Húp 2000+ lượt miễn phí - Vẽ bùa mỏi tay, Tướng 6 sao về ngay!
Nhà phát hành dành tặng người chơi hơn 2000 lượt quay tướng hoàn toàn miễn phí như một lời chào sân đầy thành ý. Ngay khi bước vào thế giới tà khí, bạn đã có thể khai đàn, vẽ bùa và triệu hồi liên tục mà không cần đắn đo tài nguyên. Hàng nghìn cơ hội mở phong ấn, săn tìm Tướng 6 sao đang chờ đón, giúp hành trình trấn áp quỷ thần khởi đầu thuận lợi và bùng nổ ngay từ những phút đầu tiên.

- 6 loại trận đồ - 9 ô chiến thuật - 69 kiểu chơi
Sở hữu 6 loại trận đồ biến hóa, kết hợp cùng 9 ô chiến thuật linh hoạt, người chơi có thể tự do sáng tạo đến 69 kiểu vận hành đội hình khác nhau. Mỗi cách sắp xếp là một thế trận riêng với quy luật khắc chế, mỗi sự thay đổi là một bước xoay chuyển cục diện - nơi tư duy chiến thuật quyết định thắng bại, không chỉ sức mạnh đơn thuần.

- Chưa vào game – Chưa biết thế nào là mãn nhãn.
Đồ họa quỷ thần được khắc họa đầy ám ảnh và choáng ngợp, từ pháp trận rực linh hỏa đến những thực thể hắc hóa phủ đầy tà khí. Mỗi khung hình đều dày đặc hiệu ứng, ánh sáng và chuyển động sống động, tạo nên cảm giác như đang bước vào một thế giới ma mị u ám thực thụ. Chưa đặt chân vào game - chưa thể cảm nhận hết thế nào là mãn nhãn.

- Thí luyện vô hạn tầng - Sai hệ dừng bước - Đúng hệ lên đỉnh.
Leo Tháp Ngũ Hệ Vô Tận là hành trình thí luyện không hồi kết giữa màn sương tà khí dày đặc. Mỗi tầng tháp là một thử thách khắc nghiệt của ngũ hành tương khắc - chọn sai hệ, lập tức dừng bước; chọn đúng hệ, phá ấn mà tiến lên đỉnh cao. data.description_full:
累計発行部数3000万部、全世界で爆発的な人気を誇るファンタジー小説「龍族」が群像劇RPGで登場！
AIアシスタント搭載、魅力的なキャラで爽快バトル、新たなIFルートで運命を廻せ！

▼没入感の高いストーリーとIFストーリー
世界中で大人気の原作小説を元に構築した300万文字を超える濃厚なストーリー。
豪華声優陣の熱演によりさまざまな名場面や名台詞を再現。
本作だけのオリジナルIFルートを多数実装し、全キャラとデートも可能に！
原作では描かれなかった未知なる可能性を、あなたの手で体験しよう！

▼今なら最大400連分無料ガチャ！ログインだけで全キャラ解放のチャンス！
キャラクターの収集ハードルは低めに設定！
ログインボーナスでは、恒常・限定を問わず多くのキャラクターが入手可能！
イベント報酬も充実！ 魅力的なキャラを仲間に迎え絆を深めよう！

▼セミオート王道RPG×策略×爽快バトル
キャラクターの編成や絆の発動など、あなたの戦略次第でバトルはより楽しく奥深く変化する！
オートプレイモードもあるので、カジュアルにも楽しめる！
キャラクターごとにバトル中の専用演出もあるので、爽快感UP！
策略を駆使して、言霊を放て！

▼デイリーミッションはAIにお任せ！
ゲーム内にはAI助手“ノルマ”を実装。
ボタンひとつで面倒なデイリーミッションなどをAIがオールクリア。キャラ育成も超簡単。
より快適に、より自由に、ストレスフリーで『ドラガク』を楽しめる！

▼世界を広げる豊富なイベントとコンテンツ
バトルやメインストーリー以外にも、数多くのミニゲームやサブストーリーを実装！
月毎にイベントも実装し、さまざまな角度から『ドラガク』の世界をディープに遊びつくそう！

▼豪華なサウンドと演出
テーマ曲《IVORY TOWER》はさまざまなアニメやドラマのサウンドを手掛ける澤野弘之氏が担当。
さらに美麗なキャラクター、迫力あるCG演出、Live2Dによる繊細な動きが、新たな『龍族』の世界へあなたを導きます！
豪華声優陣が続々出演（五十音順）
石川界人、伊東健人、小倉唯、鬼頭明里、黒沢ともよ、小林裕介、関根瞳、能登麻美子、広瀬裕也、堀江瞬、前野智昭 他（敬称略）

▼ストーリー
遥か昔、この星は【黒の龍王】ニードホッグを創造した。
そして【黒の龍王】は、【白の龍王】をはじめとするすべての竜の始祖となった。
【黒の龍王】は錬金術と言霊で人間たちを支配し、この世界に君臨した。
その後、【黒の龍王】は四大君主と呼ばれる4対の龍王を創造し、【白の龍王】は人間との間に多くの混血種たちを残した。
世界は竜族を中心に廻っているかのように見えたが……
ある日、【黒の龍王】が暗殺されたことで世界は一変した。
これこそが、竜族と人間、そして混血種たちの気の遠くなるほど長い歴史のはじまりだった。
さまざまな思惑が錯綜する世界で、竜の討伐を目的としたカッセル学院を舞台に、新たな運命の輪が廻り始める。

data.description_full:
Goal Master League is a football club management experience built around a unique tactical free kick duel. Instead of a generic arcade match, the game puts you in the role of a professional coach who must read moving defenders, judge shot power, and bend the ball past a reactive goalkeeper to win each match.

The core gameplay is a custom-built penalty-style challenge where every shot depends on direction, timing, and curve. Each session is a short best-of-five duel designed to feel strategic rather than repetitive.

Beyond the pitch, Goal Master League gives you a complete club environment. Review a full squad with position ratings and player stats, study football knowledge in a curated coach library, track career records and achievements, customize your club identity, and adjust gameplay settings to match your style.

Goal Master League stands out by combining club management presentation with an original skill-based shooting game that rewards precision, awareness, and smart decision making. It is simple to pick up, deep enough to master, and built as a complete football experience from kickoff to championship ambition.

data.name: Clack - Keyboard ASMR
data.description_full:
A one-handed keycap clicker. Collect keycaps with blue, red, and brown switch ASMR sounds.

Clack, clack, clack.
The smallest keycap collection game for keyboard lovers.


Every tap might drop a keycap

Press a keycap with your finger and once in a while, very rarely, a small keycap falls.
From common to rare, hero, and legendary. The moment a rare one drops, the screen sparkles and full-screen confetti bursts.


Real mechanical switch ASMR

Switch freely between three switch sounds: blue, red, and brown.
Put on your headphones, take a break, and lose yourself in the clicks.


Dex and collection

Every keycap you obtain is recorded in your dex automatically.
See a locked preview of what is out there, and unlock each one by obtaining it yourself.
Pull the same keycap again and your collection count stacks up.


Customize, make your own keycap

Common keycaps let you freely change their color and engraving to make them your own.
Hero and legendary keycaps keep their unique signature design.


Keycap fusion

Gather several keycaps of the same grade and aim for a higher grade.
The more you put in, the higher your success chance, and what comes out is up to luck.


Survival mode

Test your reflexes and chase your best score.
How many points can you rack up before time runs out?


Time attack mode

Show off the fastest fingers around.
Shave down your record and push your limits.


Keyboard settings

Switch sound, LED color, click effect, effect color, and more.
Bubble, heart, sparkle, petal, and other effects plus LED moods to make the keyboard your own.


Achievements

From a thousand taps to your first legendary find.
Twenty achievements are waiting for you.


Who is this for

- Keyboard and keycap lovers
- Fans of ASMR and collection games
- Anyone looking for a light game for the commute
- Anyone who misses the joy of rapid clicking


Privacy

Your game progress is stored on your device by default.
Only when you use the ranking and friends features is your score synced to the server anonymously, with no sign-up required.

Drop rates: https://keycap.gajami.app/probability
Contact: contact@gajami.app

ความโรแมนติกสุดพิเศษสำหรับคุณ! เพียงปลูกดอกไม้ในเกม เมื่อเก็บเกี่ยวดอกไม้ที่โตเต็มที่ คุณมีโอกาสได้รับการ์ดอวยพรดอกไม้ และแลกเป็นช่อดอกไม้สดส่งตรงถึงบ้านฟรีเลย!

〓 ปลูกดอกไม้สบายๆ ‧ สร้างสวนเฉพาะของคุณ 〓
ในสวนเฉพาะของคุณ ปลูกดูแลกล้วยไม้ ลีลาวดี ดอกมะลิ และดอกไม้มากมายด้วยมือคุณเอง เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาการปลูกที่ผ่อนคลายและบำบัดใจ ปล่อยวางความเครียดทีละนิด พร้อมสัมผัสความอบอุ่นจากเพื่อนดอกไม้ที่อยู่เคียงข้าง

〓 สนุกกับเพื่อน ‧ คลายเครียดด้วยสังคมเกม 〓
ในสวนไม่มีคำว่าเหงา! ผูกมิตรกับเพื่อนซี้ เข้าร่วมกิลด์ เยี่ยมชมสวนเพื่อน หรือแม้แต่ "แอบขโมย" ดอกไม้จากเพื่อนได้ด้วย! สัมผัสประสบการณ์การเล่นที่สนุกสนานและผ่อนคลาย ทุกการพบเจอคือความประหลาดใจ

〓 ศิลปะการจัดดอกไม้ ‧ สร้างสรรค์ชีวิตมีระดับ 〓
ดอกไม้ที่เก็บเกี่ยวไม่ได้มีไว้ชมเท่านั้น แต่ยังจัดแต่งได้อย่างอิสระ ผสมผสานแจกันและดอกไม้หลากหลายชนิด สร้างสรรค์ผลงานจัดดอกไม้ของคุณเอง ตั้งแต่เลือกสีสันไปจนถึงสไตล์ ออกแบบสุนทรียภาพที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์เฉพาะตัว

〓 บริหารร้านดอกไม้ ‧ สัมผัสชีวิตเจ้าของร้าน 〓
รับออเดอร์ จัดทำ ขาย ขยายร้านดอกไม้ของคุณทีละขั้นตอน สร้างร้านดอกไม้ยอดนิยมของคุณอย่างค่อยเป็นค่อยไป ใช้กลยุทธ์การบริหารเพื่อเพิ่มรายได้ ให้สวนและร้านค้าเติบโตไปพร้อมกัน

〓 สัตว์เลี้ยงแสนน่ารัก ‧ เยียวยาใจเป็นสองเท่า 〓
ดูแลน้องแมวน่ารักในบ้านแมว ให้อาหาร ลูบไล้ ตกแต่งพื้นที่ส่วนตัว เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาแห่งความอบอุ่นที่มีเพื่อนซี้สี่ขาอยู่เคียงข้าง!

data.name: Crowd Bus Jam
data.description_full:
🚌 Match the Passengers, Fill the Buses! 🚌

Your mission: get every waiting passenger onto the right bus. Sounds simple? Wait until you see the crowd. The platform can hold up to 64 passengers at once — and they keep coming in batches of 12.

🎨 Match by Color
Each passenger has a color. Each bus also has a color. A red passenger can only board a red bus. No exceptions. You’ll need to keep an eye on the platform and match colors carefully.

🚍 8 Seats per Bus
Every bus fits exactly 8 passengers. That means you can’t just throw random people on board. You have to fill each bus completely with the right color before it leaves.

🧠 Plan Your Platform
Passengers arrive in batches of 12. If you don’t match them quickly, the platform fills up. Once it hits 64, no more passengers can arrive — and if there’s no space for the next batch… game over. You’ll need to balance which buses to call and which colors to prioritize.

🌈 More Colors, More Chaos
As you level up, more colors appear. Passengers come in trickier patterns. The platform gets crowded fast. You’ll need quick decisions and a sharp memory to keep everything moving.

🏆 Can You Clear the Platform?
The goal is simple: get every passenger on a bus before the platform overflows. No timer, but every batch adds pressure. One wrong bus choice and you might block yourself for good.

Ready to become the ultimate dispatch master? Match those colors, fill those buses, and clear the queue! 🚦🔴🔵🟡🟢🚌

data.name: Đạo Mộng Anh Hùng 2: Ảo Mộng
data.description_full:
Chào mừng bạn đến với Dreamland – vùng đất của những giấc mơ kỳ ảo! Bạn đã sẵn sàng cho một chuyến du ngoạn cực chill tại dị giới chưa?
Ơ! Sao mình lại biến thành Mộng Linh siêu cấp đáng yêu thế này?! Tại đây, bạn sẽ hóa thân thành một vị Anh Hùng (chính là Mộng Linh đó) bí ẩn, tự tay viết nên biên niên sử phiêu lưu cực chill trên vùng đất mới. Dựng trại nghỉ ngơi, phơi nắng, thưởng thức tiệc nướng BBQ cùng hội bạn, còn gì tuyệt vời hơn nhỉ?

[TREO MÁY NHÀN HẠ – TÀI NGUYÊN ĐẦY KHO]
Ngủ ngon một giấc, tỉnh dậy thấy... kho đồ nổ tung! Chỉ cần nằm khểnh trong chăn, tài nguyên vẫn về đầy túi. Lên cấp cực dễ, dùng chung cấp độ. Ai bảo nằm một chỗ là không thể thành trùm!

[TỔ ẤM DỊ GIỚI – SỐNG CHẬM CỰC CHILL]
Gom tài nguyên dị giới, tự tay xây đắp căn nhà trong mơ. Nhâm nhi ly nước, tận hưởng cuộc sống nhàn hạ đích thực giữa thế giới kỳ ảo!

[BẢN ĐỒ ĐA DẠNG – THÁM HIỂM VÔ TẬN]
Bạn thích đồng cỏ xanh ngát, nơi gió hát và hoa cỏ khẽ chạm làn da?
Hay khao khát đứng trước biển khơi, đón sóng vỗ và tận hưởng tự do?
Bạn muốn dấn thân vào những hầm ngục bí ẩn, khám phá Lõi Nham Thạch rực lửa hay Đảo Bay giữa tầng mây? Hãy tạm gác lại những lo toan, đến với Dreamland để nhìn ngắm thế giới muôn màu kỳ ảo ngay thôi!

[CẮM TRẠI GIAO LƯU – KẾT BẠN NHẸ NHÀNG]
Lửa trại bùng lên, hương thịt nướng thơm lừng tỏa khắp không gian. Trải tấm khăn, xếp những chiếc ghế nhỏ, hãy rủ ngay hội bạn thân cùng tụ tập thôi nào~ Cùng nếm thử xem nguyên liệu dị giới hấp dẫn đến thế nào nhé! Bạn có tò mò hương vị của Đuôi Rồng sẽ ra sao không?

[RẢNH TAY KHAI CHIẾN – ĐÁNH TRẬN CỰC ĐÃ]
Giải phóng đôi tay! Sẵn sàng chiến đấu mọi lúc mọi nơi! Chỉ cần một cái chạm nhẹ, đội hình của bạn sẽ ngay lập tức mang đến những màn trình diễn kỹ năng rực rỡ và mãn nhãn.

[THÚ CƯNG ĐA DẠNG – HỘI TỤ ĐÁNG YÊU]
Mộng Linh trình làng! Không chỉ xinh xắn, những người bạn này còn là trợ thủ đắc lực khi thám hiểm! Mỗi bé đều có tuyệt chiêu riêng: tăng tốc thu thập tài nguyên hoặc tung đòn cực mạnh khi ra trận! Đáng yêu thế này, ngại gì không nuôi ngay một đàn?

data.name: Game Is Hard
data.description_full:
Game is Hard is not your typical puzzle app. This is a pure brain puzzle experience designed for players who love being challenged. With its clever, minimalist style and unexpected interactions, it blends elements of brain games, logic, and device-based exploration into a collection of brutally tricky levels and hard puzzle challenges, creating a unique hard puzzle game experience.

Every puzzle breaks the rules, no flashy animations, no rewards for guessing. Just you, your mind, and a seemingly simple task that might hide a brilliant, almost impossible solution. Whether you’re into strategy, trivia games, or iq test challenges, Game is Hard invites you to test your patience, perception, and persistence in a truly engaging hard puzzle game.

This is not about fast reflexes. It’s about slow, methodical progress. Some levels require silence. Others need movement. Many seem unsolvable, until they’re not. It’s a place for deep thinking and bold experimentation. Hints are available when needed, but progress is always earned.

If you've enjoyed titles like brain test games, logic puzzles, IQ tests, moron test or brain teaser games, and if you love dissecting a good tricky quest, this game is for you. It rewards those who think differently, the curious, the clever, the quietly stubborn.

With full support for offline games, you can play wherever and whenever you want, perfect for no wifi games, no internet games, or long travel sessions. Whether you're on airplane mode or deep underground, all puzzles remain playable.

And yes, it’s hard. In fact, some say it's difficult, others call it impossible. But every puzzle is built with purpose and can be solved with logic. Each hard level is designed to challenge your thinking in a unique way. If you're a fan of brain training, mind games, or just enjoy testing your limits, you'll find yourself right at home.

Each level is full of hidden ideas and clever mechanics waiting to be discovered. You'll experiment with sound, light, rotation, and pressure, even waiting. Solutions are not always obvious. But when you find them, the satisfaction is incredible, making it a memorable hard puzzle game experience.

Designed for fans of both classic and modern puzzle games, Game is Hard avoids the noise of the typical mobile fun games and focuses instead on clarity, challenge, and meaningful interaction. There’s no time pressure. No ads. No noise. Just deep puzzles that respect your intelligence.
Whether you see yourself as a genius, an impulse problem-solver, or simply someone who enjoys a good brainly test, this game invites you to try. And try again. And maybe finally succeed.

Features:
• Handcrafted brain puzzle levels with clever, logical solutions
• Challenging hard puzzle mechanics and unique level design
• Hints are available, but never obvious
• Works fully offline, great for no wifi games and free play
• Minimalist, flat design with zero distractions
• Touch, motion, and sound-based mechanics
• Built for players who enjoy hard, clever, and unusual challenges
• No scores or timers, just pure gameplay
data.description_short: Can you figure it out? A hard puzzle game with unexpected solutions.

data.name: Monster Tactical Echo

data.name: Tower Rush
data.description_full:
Aim for the clouds and test your architectural precision in Tower Rush, the ultimate arcade stacking challenge. Set against a beautiful urban skyline, your mission is to construct a magnificent skyscraper by carefully balancing unique home modules on top of one another. Each level brings a new beautifully designed floor, from cozy cottage-style rooms to elegant modern apartments, all swinging from a heavy-duty crane above your foundation. The secret to success lies in your timing; one tap drops the current floor, but only a perfectly aligned landing will keep your structure stable as it reaches higher into the blue.

The gameplay is a pure test of rhythm and focus that rewards a steady hand. As you successfully attach more homes to your rising tower, the momentum of the swinging crane becomes more challenging to predict, turning every new floor into a high-stakes balancing act. If your alignment is off, the tower will begin to wobble, eventually leading to a dramatic collapse that signals the end of your construction project. The goal is to see just how many floors you can stack before the laws of physics take over, pushing your previous high scores to new limits with every attempt.

Tower Rush features a vibrant and detailed art style that makes every building look like a handcrafted masterpiece. The intuitive one-button controls make it easy for anyone to pick up and play, while the increasing speed and shifting weight of the blocks provide a deep challenge for masters of the genre. Monitor your score in real-time, keep an eye on your personal best, and strive to create the most impressive residential tower the city has ever seen. It is time to start building, find your rhythm, and show the world that you have what it takes to reach the top.
data.description_short: Build the tallest neighborhood in the sky with Tower Rush!

data.name: Arrow Puzzle: Color Match Game
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Match - a FREE arrows puzzle game that combines escape logic with match 3 color strategy. Test your logic and guide the colorful arrows through a challenging brain puzzle experience!

If you love triple match games, arrow puzzles, and relaxing logic challenges, this arrow matching game is your perfect puzzle escape!

🌟 HOW TO PLAY: MASTER THE ARROW PUZZLE

↪️ TAP & COLLECT: Tap unblocked arrows and send them into the slots.
↪️ MATCH 3 COLORS: Clear slots by matching 3 arrows of the same color.
↪️ WATCH YOUR SPACE: Avoid filling the 7 slots too soon.
↪️ CLEAR THE PATTERN: Find the hidden path, and remove all arrows in the right order.

🌟 WHY THIS ARROW PUZZLE GAME STANDS OUT

🧠 Arrows Escape + Match 3 Brain Challenge
Not just arrow escape - every move shapes your next color match. Build triple match combos, solve each logic maze, and clear arrows before the slots fill up. This layered puzzle strategy makes every brain challenge more thoughtful and satisfying.

🎨 Curved Arrows & Creative Patterns
Explore stunning puzzle art made with curved arrows, instead of rigid straight lines. Each board blends stylish visuals with escape logic, triple match choices, and brain-teasing maze fun.

😌 No Life Penalty, No-Pressure Play
Tap freely without losing lives for blocked arrows. With no timer and no harsh punishment, you can rethink which arrow to move and enjoy pure logic puzzle fun.

✨ Minimalist Puzzle Style, Easy on Eyes
A soft, dark background makes arrows stand out. Stay focused, relax your eyes, and enjoy a cleaner puzzle flow for matching games.

🔍 Smart Zoom & Grid Support
Zoom in to catch details, or use Grid Hint to reveal outer arrows ready to escape. Even tricky arrow mazes become clearer as you plan each logic move.

📱 Offline Puzzle Fun Anytime
Play offline with no internet needed. Open a quick brain puzzle during commuting, traveling, taking a coffee break, or relaxing before bed - all at your own pace.

A1: It is a relaxing arrow puzzle game that combines arrows escape gameplay with triple match strategy.

data.name: Hexadrift Echo-Advanture
data.description_full:
Hexadrift Echo is a one-of-a-kind 3D cartoon puzzle sorting game that redefines the traditional block elimination genre with dynamic drifting mechanics and ethereal cosmic aesthetics. Departing from rigid static matching and simple line-clearing gameplay of classic elimination games, this title integrates hexagonal geometric logic, floating drift physics, and iterative strategic sorting, creating a relaxed yet mentally challenging gaming experience that balances casual entertainment and tactical depth. Rooted in the mysterious cosmic concept of “drifting echoes”, the game builds a unique interstellar worldview where every hexagonal block carries residual cosmic energy, and every precise sort awakens the hidden echoes of the starry void.
The core gameplay of Hexadrift Echo centers on dynamic hexagonal block sorting and drifting elimination. Players will face a continuous stream of floating hexagonal blocks that drift slowly and irregularly on the 3D cosmic battlefield, instead of stationary blocks fixed in a conventional grid. These blocks vary in color, geometric attributes, and energy traits, and the core goal is to classify and match blocks with identical attributes within a limited space and time. Different from ordinary elimination games that only require simple alignment, the drifting attribute of all blocks is the core differentiation of this game. The blocks never stay still; they sway, drift, and rotate gently with the cosmic airflow, bringing unpredictable dynamic changes to every level. Players need to observe the drifting trajectory in real time, predict the movement trend of floating blocks, and complete accurate sorting and matching before the blocks overflow the boundary or disappear, which greatly tests hand-eye coordination and spatial thinking ability.

data.name: Word Solitaire Go
data.description_full:
Word Solitaire Go is a refined word puzzle that blends the familiar structure of classic solitaire with the challenge of organizing meaning. Instead of numbers and suits, you work with complete word cards and group cards, turning a scattered table into a clear solution through thoughtful play.

How to Play
Every level begins with a partially revealed layout. You first establish the foundation by placing group cards, then draw new word cards into play and commit them to the right sets. Each placement shapes the board, opening some possibilities while quietly limiting others.
With a limited number of moves available, timing matters as much as correctness.

Strategy Over Speed
The challenge in Word Solitaire Go doesn’t come from fast reactions or memorization. It comes from judgment. Should you place a word now, or wait for more information? Should you draw another card, or stabilize what’s already on the table?
One decision can determine how the rest of the round unfolds.

Key Features
Solitaire-inspired gameplay using word and group cards
Meaning-based sorting that rewards logic and insight
A move-limited structure where every placement matters
Gradually evolving difficulty without sudden spikes
Clean, focused presentation designed for calm play

Designed for Thoughtful Players
Each session feels complete on its own, offering a clear beginning, rising tension, and a satisfying resolution. Over time, patterns become clearer, decisions sharper, and progress more rewarding.

Word Solitaire Go is calm on the surface, but deeply engaging once you lean in. It’s a game for players who enjoy focus, structure, and the quiet satisfaction of making everything fit.
data.description_short: Sort words, solve groups, and relax with solitaire-style puzzles.

Your mission is simple: Clear the grid by guiding every arrow out. But be careful—one wrong move leads to bad ending. Plan your sequence, navigate tight spaces, and find the satisfying flow of a perfectly executed escape.

Why You’ll Love This Puzzle
- Minimalist Zen: A clean, distraction-free interface that lets you focus entirely on the logic of the arrows.

CORE GAMEPLAY
- Intuitive Controls: Simple tap-to-move mechanics that feel smooth and responsive.
- Heart System: Every tap counts! Avoid blocked paths to keep your hearts intact and finish with a perfect score.

HOW TO PLAY
- Analyze the Grid: Look for arrows that have a clear, unobstructed path to the edge.
- Tap to Release: Tap an arrow to send it flying out. This opens up space for the arrows behind it.
- Plan the Sequence: The order is everything. Solve the "traffic jam" by thinking two or three steps ahead.
- Clear the Board: Successfully remove all arrows to complete the level and earn a mental "clean slate"

Arrow Out - Tap and Go is more than just game, it’s a digital pocket of peace. Whether you have two minutes or two hours, it’s the perfect way to sharpen your logic while letting go of the day's chaos.

Download now and start your journey toward a clearer mind!

data.name: Chicken Road
data.description_full:
Enjoy a calm and colorful casual arcade game with bright lanes and fun sorting mechanics. The gameplay is simple and relaxing: different items such as golden eggs, white feathers, shining coins and fiery elements fall down from the top of the screen. Your task is to drag each item to the correct lane where it belongs.
Each lane has its own receiver at the bottom: one for eggs, one for feathers, one for coins and one for fire. When you place an item in the right lane, you earn points. If you send an item to the wrong lane, especially fire to the wrong place, you lose one of your three lives. The game ends when you run out of lives. The visuals are vibrant and pleasant with a rich purple and gold color scheme, sparkling particle effects, and a cheerful cartoon chicken character with sunglasses at the bottom of the screen. Everything moves smoothly with satisfying animations when items land in the correct lanes.Controls are very easy - simply drag the falling items left or right to the proper lane. The game gives you enough time to observe and react, making it suitable for relaxed play. This makes the game perfect for short sessions or when you want to improve your best score after several attempts. Each round ends with a clear summary of your result.
This casual game is ideal for quiet moments when you need light and focused entertainment. The sound effects are soft and satisfying, with gentle placement sounds and calm background music that keeps the mood positive. The overall experience feels approachable and suitable for players of all ages who enjoy simple sorting and matching-style arcade games.
Return to the sorting lanes whenever you want an easy and enjoyable distraction. With its straightforward drag controls, clear item categories, and gentle difficulty, this casual game offers a relaxing way to sort falling items, avoid mistakes, and gradually improve your score. Drag each item thoughtfully to its correct lane, watch the points add up, and enjoy the calm satisfaction of steady gameplay in this pleasant arcade experience.

data.name: Coco Road
data.description_full:
Coco Road is a sunrise-themed crash game where every round is a daring sprint of a golden hen across a country dawn. Unlike standard crash titles built around abstract rockets or planes, Coco Road wraps the rising multiplier in a hand-drawn farm scene: the chick flaps along a hayfield trail while a roadside utility pole approaches as the visible crash threat. Cash out before the collision, or watch your wager scatter like loose feathers.
What sets Coco Road apart is the layered farm-life economy that surrounds the core round. Two original modifiers reshape every flight. Morning Dew is a random in-air event that glides over the screen and slows the multiplier growth for three seconds, giving disciplined players a window to push further with reduced risk. Double Nest opens a Twin Nest panel so two independent wagers ride the same flight and can be cashed out at separate moments, turning a single round into a tactical decision rather than a single tap.
The Plumage Atelier offers five distinct feather skins, each one tied to a real gameplay bonus rather than just a cosmetic recolor. Amber Quill keeps the round balanced, Peach Zephyr lifts every payout, Hayfield Crest enlarges every daily harvest, Sunset Ember rewards long flights above three times the wager, and Horizon Halo combines an extra payout with a richer daily grain claim. The Daily Grains silo gives a free harvest every day with a seven-day streak ladder, so consistent visits always pay off, even without spending grains on a flight.
data.description_short: Coco Road is a sunrise-themed crash game

data.name: Chick Road Game
data.description_full:
Chick Road Game is a pocket-sized Mexican-themed arcade adventure built around one idea: guide a brave little chicken across busy lanes filled with traffic, spicy hazards, and desert surprises. Each stage stretches the path a little further, asks you to collect cinnamon churros along the way, and rewards careful timing more than speed.

Unlike generic endless runners, the game frames every hop as a short crossing puzzle on a colorful village street. You slide sideways when you need space, hop forward when the lane opens, and learn how different obstacles behave so you can reach the finish strip without losing your three hearts.

Outside the Road-style crossing mode, the app doubles as a light cultural companion: swipe through bite-sized fun facts about Mexican traditions and open illustrated recipe cards for classic chicken dishes with clear ingredients and cooking steps. Progress and preferences stay on your device, so you can play offline and pick up exactly where you left off.

If you want a cheerful, family-friendly title that mixes reflex-based crossings with food lore and quick reads, Chick Road Game keeps the pace relaxed, the visuals warm, and the focus squarely on crossing the street your way.

data.name: Tower Rush
data.description_full: Tower Rush features a precision-based building gameplay where players stack moving platforms to construct an ever-rising tower. The objective is to align each drop as accurately as possible to maintain width and keep the structure stable. Platforms slide across the screen, and players must release them at the right moment to land on top of the tower. Any misalignment trims the platform, making the next placement more difficult. As the tower grows, movement speed increases, demanding sharper focus and faster reactions. The challenge evolves through continuous stacking, where consistency and rhythm become essential. Smaller margins and faster motion create a progressively demanding experience that tests timing and control.

data.name: Tower Charge Rush
data.description_full:
Tower Charge Rush is an addictive arcade game that combines quick reactions, timing, and enjoyable progression mechanics in a fast-paced and addictive experience. Designed for players who enjoy quick decision-making and rewarding gameplay loops, the game challenges you to interact with falling items and accumulate powerful charges to achieve high scores.

The core gameplay of Tower Charge Rush revolves around catching and interacting with items falling from the top of the screen. As these items fall, your task is to stay focused and be ready to act at the right moment. Once an item reaches the bottom, you have a limited time to touch it. This time window can become shorter depending on the game mode, increasing the difficulty as you progress.

Each successful touch contributes to the charging of the item. Each interaction increases its charge level by one, gradually building it up to its maximum capacity. This creates a sense of progression with each interaction, encouraging you to stay engaged and keep tapping accurately.

Once an item reaches full charge, it disappears. This moment is visually pleasing and rewarding, as it symbolizes the successful completion of your efforts. Fully charged items don’t just disappear—they explode from above, creating dynamic visuals and awarding you valuable points.

This explosion mechanic is a key part of the game’s loop. It provides clear feedback on your success and motivates you to continue charging more items efficiently. The faster and more accurately you act, the more explosions you can trigger, resulting in higher scores and a more immersive experience.

Timing is crucial in Tower Charge Rush. You must balance speed with accuracy, ensuring you tap items in the allotted time while maintaining a steady rhythm. Missing an item or reacting too late can interrupt your flow and reduce your potential for scoring points.

To keep the gameplay fresh and customizable, Tower Charge Rush includes a variety of settings that allow you to tailor the gameplay to your preferences. You can adjust the speed of the game, choosing between increasing difficulty over time or a more steady pace. This flexibility makes the game suitable for both casual players and those looking for a greater challenge.

The game also features a vibration option that enhances immersion by providing physical feedback during interactions. Enabling vibration can make every tap and event feel more impressive, adding another layer of engagement to the gameplay.

Another exciting feature is the daily gift system. Once a day, you can receive a reward that will help you progress or improve your gameplay. If you don't want to wait, the system allows you to reset the timer and access your reward immediately, keeping the gameplay smooth and rewarding.

Additionally, you can customize the elements used in the game, allowing you to personalize the visual and gameplay experience. This adds variety and ensures that each session is a little different.

Tower Charge Rush is designed to be easy to understand, yet highly addictive to master. Simple mechanics make it accessible from the first playthrough, while the increasing speed and need for precision ensure a long-term challenge and replayability.

Each session becomes a test of your reflexes and consistency. The more accurately you tap and charge the elements, the more rewards you receive and the higher your score grows. Over time, you will improve your timing, develop a better rhythm and achieve more impressive results.

Whether you are looking for a fast and addictive arcade game or you are looking to master every aspect of the game, Tower Charge Rush offers a refined and rewarding experience. Focus, tap at the right moment and launch powerful explosions to dominate the scoreboard.
data.description_short: Tap, charge, explode, score big!

data.name: Arrow Rush 3D
data.description_full:
Imagine a 3D cube covered in arrows. Some point straight ahead. Others twist around corners — stretching across two or even three faces. Your job? Tap each arrow in the right direction to make it fly off the cube. Sounds simple? Wait until they start crossing paths.

🎯 How It Works
Every arrow has a direction — up, down, left, right, or a bendy path that wraps around the cube. You need to tap an arrow so it follows its direction and leaves the cube cleanly. But here’s the catch: arrows must not crash into each other. A wrong tap could send two arrows straight into a collision!

🔄 Inspect Every Angle
The cube is fully rotatable. Drag to spin it, zoom in to see the tricky corners, and study how arrows connect across faces. Some arrows hide their tails on the other side. Only by looking from every angle can you figure out the right order.

🧠 Plan Your Taps
It’s not just about tapping fast. You have to think ahead — which arrow should go first? Which one will block another if you tap too early? The arrows are interlocked like a puzzle knot. Solve the sequence and watch them all fly away.

🧩 More Than Just a Cube
As you progress, the arrows get crazier — longer paths, tighter turns, and more overlapping routes. Each level is a new brain‑teaser that makes you twist your thinking along with the cube.

Ready to twist, tap, and untangle? Grab the cube and let the arrows find their way home! 🔄➡️⬆️⬇️🔲
data.description_short: Click the arrows to make them leave the cube.

In this intense combat shooting world, you operate powerful military weapons positioned across dangerous warzones, tasked with intercepting enemy forces approaching from the air, sea, and land. Fighter planes streak across the sky, naval vessels cut through open water, and armored vehicles advance across the ground in the middle of large-scale battles. Your role is to stay calm under pressure, follow the movement of each target, and release a perfectly timed shot that turns the tide of battle.

Each weapon can be upgraded to increase its damage, bullet speed, rate of fire, and overall war shooting power. Your battles will take place across diverse war operations inspired by different theaters of conflict: Warsaw, Gibraltar, Pearl Harbor and more. Download Medal Hunter and enter the ultimate shooting battlefield.

data.name: Meowdoku: Brain Puzzle Games
data.description_full:
Looking for a game that soothes the soul but keeps your brain spinning? Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the rigorous reasoning of Sudoku with the thrilling deduction of Minesweeper.
Here, you have only one mission: find the perfect "exclusive territory" for every aloof little cat!
💡 Simple Rules, Deep Strategy
The concept is elegant and intuitive, yet anything but simple:
• Exclusive Territory: The board is divided into colored sections. You must place exactly one cat in each section.
• The Aloof Rule: Cats need absolute personal space! They absolutely cannot share the same row, column, or touch each other—not even diagonally.
• Risk & Reward: Double-tap a tile to place a cat. You only have 3 chances to make a mistake (hearts). Guess right, and you're rewarded with pure puzzle-solving satisfaction; guess wrong, and you lose a heart. Guessing won't save you; every single move must be carefully calculated!
✨ Key Features
🐾 Pure & Immersive Experience
- Non-Intrusive Ads: Zero interruptions to your gameplay, letting you fully enjoy a completely focused, Zen-like flow state.
- Play Offline Anytime: No internet required. Perfectly fills up the puzzle-shaped hole in your daily commute, time spent waiting in line, or your morning coffee break.
📅 Daily Brain Teasers
- Wake up your mind with brand-new "Daily Puzzles" every single day.
- Push your limits and see if you can break your fastest completion times on the global leaderboards.
❤️ Why Meowdoku Will Stay on Your Phone
Meowdoku won't hijack your attention with tedious social mechanics or endless daily grinds—it earns your love through pure gameplay quality. With its minimalist aesthetic and satisfying tactile feedback, it takes just seconds to learn. Yet, long after you put your phone down, its elegant logic loop will keep lingering in your mind.
Ready for a brain-teasing puzzle adventure filled with adorable felines?
Download Meowdoku now, put your logic to the test, and become the ultimate feline puzzle master!

But watch out—ropes can cross, loop, and wind around obstacles, creating tricky Knots that demand careful planning. The game uses a realistic physics engine, so ropes glide and resist with natural weight. Every second counts, adding just the right amount of challenge to each Puzzle. As you progress, you'll encounter fixed anchors, multi-point ropes, and uniquely shaped connectors that bring fresh layers of Logic and Match-based fun.
Key Features
- Realistic Physics Puzzle: Ropes bend, wrap, and interact with lifelike tension. Every drag feels tactile, making each solution deeply satisfying.
- Simple One-Touch Controls: Just pick a rope end and slide it to the target spot. Easy to learn, yet packed with brain-teasing logic challenges.
- Clever Obstacles & Tools: Beat the clock and tackle complex knots with handy power-ups like Freeze Time or the Axe. Stuck? Use hints to spot the right move and keep the fun flowing.
- Soothing ASMR Ambience: Gentle sounds accompany every pull and snap, creating a calming backdrop that helps you focus and unwind.
- Endless Variety: From basic two-end ropes to L-shaped connectors and multi-point strands, each level introduces new Connect puzzles to keep your mind engaged.
Why You'll Love It？
- A perfect blend of relaxation and mental exercise—ideal for sharpening your logic during short breaks.
- The gentle time limit adds a touch of excitement without overwhelming pressure. Solve each knot at your own pace within the countdown.
- The physics feel just right: ropes slide smoothly, overlap naturally, and click into place with a rewarding snap.
- Regular updates add fresh layouts and clever new rope types, ensuring Puzzle Fun never gets old.
Ready to Untangle the Fun?
Download Rope Escape Master and dive into a world of soothing physics puzzles. Drag, connect, and unravel your way to a clearer mind—one satisfying knot at a time.

data.name: JigTown - Puzzle
data.description_full:
I. Core Gameplay​
Drag and rotate puzzle pieces to align them, restore high-definition images, unlock levels and achievements. A relaxing, stress-relieving, and brain-training experience.​
II. 3 Game Modes at a Glance​
Classic Puzzle: Regular rectangular pieces with grid layout, beginner-friendly. Start by assembling the frame, then fill in the middle.​
Fragment Reassembly: Irregular polygonal pieces, intermediate difficulty. Match textures and shapes—adjacent pieces can be highlighted for assistance.​
Special-Shaped Puzzle: 3D interlocking pieces (with protrusions and indentations), hard difficulty. Find the interlocking points and align them precisely to lock in place.​
III. Basic Controls (Super Simple)​
Long-press to drag pieces; double-tap to rotate.​
Pinch to zoom in/out for overall view or detailed checks.​
Progress auto-saves—resume gameplay anytime after exiting.

data.name: Glam Screw: Beauty Sort

Game Concept: Logic Wrapped in Elegance
Glam Screw isn't just about turning a nail; it’s about the art of the sort. Every board is a complex arrangement of wood panels held together by vibrant, metallic fasteners. As you navigate these intricate structures, you’ll find that every move counts. One wrong move could lead to a jam, blocking your path and testing your patience.

The core of the game revolves around your ability to master the mechanics of space and color. By carefully selecting which pins to remove first, you create a satisfying flow that clears the board and unveils the stunning beauty hidden beneath the surface.

Exquisite Game Features
- Aesthetic Rewards: We believe hard work deserves a beautiful reward. Every level you conquer brings you closer to unlocking exclusive, high-quality wallpapers featuring stunning beauty photography and art.
- Brain Training: Challenge your cognitive limits. This game is designed to enhance your spatial awareness, logical reasoning, and problem-solving skills. It’s the perfect workout for a sharp mind.
- The Woodwork Aesthetic: Enjoy the high-fidelity graphics that simulate the grain and texture of real wood. The haptic feedback and crisp sound effects make every twist of the nail feel incredibly realistic.
- Tension and Relief: Navigate through tricky board scenarios where the board is crowded. Feel the immense satisfaction as you find the key to loosening the grid and watching the panels fall away.
- Free Collection: All unlocked wallpapers are yours to keep! Download your favorite beauty backgrounds directly to your device and refresh your screen whenever you like.

How to Play: Step-by-Step
- Observe the Board: Look at the layers of wood and the colorful screws holding them in place.
- Pick Your Target: Tap on a nail or screw to move it into the storage slots. Remember, space in the slots is limited!

- Reveal the Art: As the panels drop, the background beauty image is revealed. Clear the entire board to "finish" the art and add it to your gallery.

data.name: عهد الأبطال: نصل الحق
data.description_full:
[عهد الأبطال: نصل الحق —— الملحمة الخيالية الأكثر واقعية]
"بالحقيقة نطفئ نار العصر، وبالإرادة نعيد تشكيل العالم"
في عصر يسوده الظلام، أنت وحدك من يحمل نصل الحق، لتحطم القيود وتُخلِّد أسطورتك!

انغمس في عالم MMORPG أسطوري. من تخصيص الأبطال المهيبين إلى معارك الحصار الملحمية، "عهد الأبطال: نصل الحق" ليست مجرد لعبة، بل هي رحلة لإعادة صياغة مصيرك في عالم مليء بالعجائب.

—— نظام الفئات المتطور ——
من الظلال إلى السيادة: اختر طريقك من بين فئات قتالية صُممت بدقة فائقة. سواء اخترت مهارات "المغتال" المتخفي أو بأس المحارب الجبار، ستُحس بقوة إرادتك وهي تُحوِّل بطلك من محارب في الظلام إلى أسطورة تقود الميدان وتغير موازين القوى.

—— فخامة التصميم والجماليات الواقعية ——
أناقة الفرسان الأوفياء: ارتدِ دروعاً وأزياءً أسطورية تعكس هيبة أبطال عالمنا وفخامتهم. نحن نؤمن بأن "الحقيقة" تكمن في التفاصيل؛ لذا قمنا بتصميم أجنحة متلألئة وخيول أسطورية بمعايير جمالية عالية، تمنحك مظهراً مهيباً يفرض احترامه في كل ركن من أركان الممالك التسعة.

—— القتال، العتاد والسيطرة ——
أطفئ نيران الحرب بيدك: تحدَّ زعماء العالم في معارك طاحنة لانتزاع أندر الأسلحة والدروع. كل قطعة عتاد تحصل عليها هي خطوة نحو "إعادة تشكيل العالم". سيطر على ساحات PvP وأثبت أن إرادتك هي القوة الأسمى التي لا يمكن قهرها.

—— نمو ذكي وتطور تلقائي ——
حرر يديك واستمتع بالحرية: لأن وقت البطل ثمين، وفرنا لك نظام قتال تلقائي متقدم يتيح لك رفع مستواك وجمع الموارد بمنتهى السلاسة. حتى وأنت بعيد، يظل بطلك ينمو ويقوى، لتكون دائماً مستعداً لإطفاء نيران الأزمات التي تهدد العصر.

—— تحالفات قوية وروابط اجتماعية ——
قوة الجماعة في نصل واحد: أنشئ "عشيرة" قوية وانخرط في حروب حصار ملحمية مع إخوة السلاح. بفضل نظام التواصل الصوتي المتطور والميزات الاجتماعية العميقة، ستجد من يشاركونك الإرادة لتصنعوا معاً مجد المستقبل في هذا العالم الأسطوري.

—— أهم مميزات اللعبة ——
جوهر الأسطورة: "بالحقيقة نطفئ نار العصر" - قصة عميقة مستوحاة من أساطير الفايكنج الخالدة.
إرادة التغيير: "وبالإرادة نعيد تشكيل العالم" - نظام تطوير شخصيات حر ومتعدد الأبعاد.
محتوى محلي حصري: أزياء وفعاليات صُممت خصيصاً لتلائم أذواق أبطالنا وتُجسِّد هيبتهم.

data.name: Tower Jump Rush
data.description_full:
Tower Jump Rush features a structure-building gameplay where players stack house blocks layer by layer to create a stable tower. The core experience focuses on timing, alignment, and maintaining balance as the structure grows taller.

Blocks move horizontally across the screen, and players must release them at the right moment to place each floor accurately. Perfect alignment keeps the tower stable, while misplacement trims the structure and increases difficulty for the next layer.

As the tower rises, movement speed increases and placement precision becomes more critical. Smaller surfaces and faster motion require consistent control and quick reactions to maintain progress.

The gameplay centers on continuous stacking, where each decision affects the stability of the entire structure. Players aim to build higher towers while managing narrowing space and increasing pace.

Players earn in-game currency through successful construction, which can be used to unlock different building styles, visual themes, and gameplay variations.

data.name: Water Loop Puzzle
data.description_full:
Welcome to Water Loop Puzzle, a refreshing twist on the classic water sort genre. If you enjoy satisfying color sorting, relaxing gameplay, and smart mechanics, this game is for you. By combining traditional water sort gameplay with a unique loop conveyor system, it turns simple sorting into a dynamic and strategic experience.

🌊 Introduction

Water Loop Puzzle is not just another sorting game—it’s a creative evolution. Instead of pouring water directly between tubes, you use a loop-based conveyor that moves water around the board. This adds a new layer of timing, planning, and logic.

Your goal is simple: sort colors so each tube contains only one color. The challenge comes from how you do it—every move flows through the loop system, requiring foresight.

🔄 Core Gameplay

This loop puzzle revolves around movement and strategy. Tap a tube to place its top water layer onto a moving conveyor. The loop carries it across tubes, and you decide where to drop it.

- Move only the top layer
- Place onto same color or empty tube
- Use the loop to transport water
- Sort all colors to win

This transforms the classic water sort into something more dynamic and engaging.

🧠 Why It Feels Different

The loop system changes everything:

- You must think ahead
- Timing and positioning matter
- Every move is part of a cycle

The loopy flow creates a smooth, connected experience. It’s not just about sorting—it’s about understanding the system.

🎮 How to Play

1. Tap a tube to pick up the top layer
2. Place it onto the conveyor loop
3. Let the loop carry it
4. Drop it into a valid tube
5. Repeat until fully sorted

⚙️ Rules

- Only move top layers
- Match colors or use empty tubes
- Tubes have limited space
- The loop moves continuously

🔑 Strategy Tips

- Plan ahead before placing
- Use empty tubes wisely
- Avoid blocking stacks
- Think in cycles, not steps

🌈 Experience

Enjoy smooth animations, vibrant colors, and a clean UI. Every move feels fluid and satisfying, making the game both relaxing and engaging.

🧩 Progression

Levels start simple and grow more complex with more tubes and colors. Each stage challenges your logic without overwhelming you.

🔄 A New Take

Water Loop Puzzle blends loop sort mechanics with classic water sort gameplay. The loopkey concept—understanding flow—is key to mastering the game. It’s a fresh take on a familiar logic puzzle.

🧠 Benefits

- Improves logic and focus
- Enhances problem-solving
- Encourages strategic thinking
- Provides stress relief

🎯 Who It’s For

Perfect for puzzle lovers, casual players, and anyone who enjoys relaxing yet challenging games.

💡 What Makes It Special

- Unique loop system
- Fresh gameplay twist
- Smooth, satisfying flow
- Smart level design

data.name: DesiLudo
data.description_full:
The rules are very simple, anyone can start and quickly become a master.

At the start of the game, each player begins with four pieces on their starting square. During the game, players take turns rolling the dice. A 6 is rolled, and that player's piece is placed on their starting square. The main objective is to remove all four pieces from your side of the board before any of your opponents.

- A piece can only move when a 6 is rolled.
- Players take turns rolling the dice. If a player rolls a 6, they get another chance to roll.
- All pieces must reach the center of the board to win the game.
- Pieces move clockwise based on the number rolled on the dice.
- Knocking down an opponent's piece grants an extra chance to roll the dice.

Spending happy times together, constantly improving your chess skills, showcasing your personal talents, and becoming a master player!

data.name: IK: Infinity Kingdom - Funtap
data.description_full:
Quyết định phê duyệt nội dung kịch bản trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số: QĐ số 142/QĐ-PTTH&TTĐT do Cục PTTH&TTĐT cấp ngày 25/03/2026.
https://giayphep.abei.gov.vn/g1/132046

Infinity Kingdom là tựa game chiến thuật thời gian thực (SLG) đưa bạn bước vào một thế giới giả tưởng rộng lớn, nơi các nền văn minh giao thoa và những danh tướng huyền thoại cùng hội tụ. Tại đây, bạn sẽ vào vai một lãnh chúa, xây dựng vương quốc hùng mạnh, phát triển kinh tế, nghiên cứu công nghệ và từng bước mở rộng lãnh thổ để khẳng định vị thế của mình trên bản đồ thế giới.

Điểm nổi bật của Infinity Kingdom nằm ở hệ thống Immortal – nơi quy tụ các anh hùng lịch sử như Julius Caesar, Cleopatra, Thành Cát Tư Hãn… được tái hiện với phong cách đồ họa 3D sống động. Mỗi Immortal sở hữu bộ kỹ năng riêng biệt, cho phép bạn tự do xây dựng đội hình chiến thuật theo nhiều hướng khác nhau: công – thủ – hỗ trợ, tạo nên chiều sâu chiến lược và khả năng biến hóa linh hoạt trong từng trận chiến.

Không chỉ dừng lại ở việc phát triển thành phố, người chơi còn được tham gia vào các trận chiến PvP quy mô lớn, liên minh bang hội, và đặc biệt là các cuộc chiến tranh lãnh thổ khốc liệt. Tính năng Liên minh (Alliance) đóng vai trò then chốt, nơi bạn có thể hợp tác với bạn bè, chia sẻ tài nguyên, hỗ trợ nhau trong chiến đấu và cùng nhau thống trị các khu vực quan trọng.

Bên cạnh đó, Infinity Kingdom còn mang đến trải nghiệm khám phá rồng nguyên tố độc đáo. Người chơi có thể thu thập, huấn luyện và nâng cấp các loại rồng với sức mạnh khác nhau, từ đó kết hợp cùng đội hình Immortal để tối ưu hóa sức mạnh chiến đấu. Đây chính là yếu tố tạo nên sự khác biệt so với các tựa game SLG truyền thống.

Với đồ họa 3D sắc nét, hiệu ứng chiến đấu hoành tráng cùng hệ thống gameplay đa dạng, Infinity Kingdom không chỉ đòi hỏi tư duy chiến lược mà còn mang đến cảm giác chinh phục đầy kịch tính. Dù bạn là người chơi yêu thích xây dựng, chiến đấu hay cạnh tranh đỉnh cao, tựa game này đều mang đến một hành trình phát triển và khẳng định bản thân không giới hạn.

Hãy gia nhập Infinity Kingdom ngay hôm nay để xây dựng đế chế của riêng bạn, tập hợp đội quân huyền thoại và viết nên câu chuyện chinh phục của chính mình!
data.description_short: Xây dựng đế chế, chiêu mộ danh tướng và chinh phục thế giới Infinity Kingdom!

data.name: Line to Jewels
data.description_full:
In this game, the Trickster navigates levels designed around precise card throws. Each level is filled with stones and different objects that shape the path — some block the way, while others help create useful ricochets. Every stage is a small challenge. It's not just about throwing a card; it's also about understanding how the card will behave after impact and planning the most efficient path.

How to play?
Press and hold on the screen, then drag your finger to choose the direction of the throw. A trajectory line appears, showing the card’s flight path. When you release your finger, the card flies forward, either traveling in a straight line or bouncing off objects and hitting stones along the way. The goal is simple — clear all stones in the level within a limited number of throws, using ricochets and smart angles.

The game is easy to pick up, with no complex systems to overwhelm you, so you'll feel comfortable from the very first seconds. To make onboarding even smoother, the game includes a built-in tutorial that guides players step by step through the mechanics. At the same time, each level encourages experimentation and different solutions, keeping the gameplay varied without becoming complicated. The game includes customizable environments, allowing players to adjust the visual style of levels to their liking and become more immersed in the world. It also features background music that supports the pace of gameplay and enhances the overall experience without distracting players.

data.name: Celestia: Immortal path
data.description_full:
Celestia: Immortal path — это изысканная и визуально чарующая мобильная игра, вдохновлённая древним мифологическим эпосом «Шань Хай цзин» (Классика гор и морей).
Шань Хай сияет, как рассвет славы,
Друзья и магия ведут сквозь миры.
Тактика битв решает судьбы,
Процветают угодья, растут богатства.
Соберите соратников — И бросьте вызов эпическому боссу!
Её миры и духи персонажей созданы на основе легенд о богах, демонах и мифических существах Востока, оживающих в новом фантастическом облике. В древние времена разразилась великая война между кланом ведьм и кланом демонов. В той битве пали три владыки демонов и двенадцать наследственных ведьм. Из хаоса восстал Великий Демон Тайхао, объединивший демонов и положивший конец смуте. Но затаённая ненависть ведьм привлекла демона-бога Се Ту, который заточил Тайхао, вновь ввергнув мир в хаос. Демон-бог Сюаньюань выступил против Се Ту. Потерпев поражение, Се Ту бежал, но Янь Мо, движимый жаждой мести, принял облик Тайхао и устроил засаду. Сюаньюань был тяжело ранен, и лишь крошечный осколок его души уцелел, затерявшись в хаосе.
