data.name: Zevion
data.description_full:
Zevion is a puzzle game built around strategic tile placement and crystal merging mechanics.
The playing field consists of a grid of cells. At the bottom of the screen, you always have three tiles available, each containing one to four crystals. Your goal is to place these tiles into the grid cells, positioning them carefully to trigger merges and clear the board.
When adjacent cells contain tiles with matching crystals, those crystals automatically combine into a single tile if space allows. Once a tile is completely filled with identical crystals, it is destroyed and you earn points. The more efficiently you plan your placements, the higher your score.
As you progress, new levels become available, each introducing a wider variety of crystal types that require more thoughtful decisions and longer-term planning. To unlock a new level, you need to collect a specific amount of each crystal type, which encourages mastering the current level before advancing.
Your collection progress across all crystal types is displayed clearly in the main menu, so you always know how close you are to unlocking the next level.
Zevion is designed for players who enjoy logic puzzles, spatial thinking, and incremental progression systems. Each session can be played in a few minutes, making it suitable for short breaks as well as longer play sessions.

data.name: Fieryy Fruits
data.description_full:
Fieryy Fruits is an easy and exciting puzzle game 🍓 that is nice to enter “for a moment”… and get stuck in for a long time ⏳

Everything is simple and clear from the first seconds: find the same fruits 🍎🍊🍇 and remove them from the field. Touch the tile - it will light up ✨, choose the same one - and the pair will disappear 💥 Easy? Not really 🤔

The trick of the game is that you can only choose free tiles 🔓 And only the one on which there is nothing and which has at least one side open is considered free. Therefore, you will have to think a little before making a move 🧠

With each level, the field becomes more difficult, and victory becomes more pleasant 🏆 This is the same type of game where you constantly tell yourself “one more level - and that's it” 😄

Fieryy Fruits is an ideal option to relax 🌿, clear your head a little and at the same time train your attentiveness 👀

data.name: Build RollerCoaster: Simulator
data.description_full:
This game is a creative obby game where you design, build, and ride your own roller coaster tracks in a colorful, block-based world inspired by Roblox-style games 🎢 Create exciting rides, experiment with track layouts, and experience every coaster you build from start to finish 🚀

This is not just an obby about passing obstacles. It is a full building experience where you construct roller coaster tracks using blocks and interactive elements 🧱 Start with simple layouts, expand your construction, and transform your ideas into fully rideable roller coasters that you can test and improve.

Core Gameplay
The gameplay is focused on building and riding roller coaster tracks. You place track pieces step by step, connecting turns, slopes, and drops into complete coaster rides 🛤 Each piece you add brings your roller coaster closer to a finished track. When it is ready, you can jump into a cart and ride the entire construction yourself 🎢

Every roller coaster feels different depending on your design. You experience speed, movement, and every turn exactly as you created it. By riding your tracks and completing obby paths, you earn in-game currency 💰 This currency lets you unlock more track elements and continue building larger and more complex roller coasters.

The controls are simple and responsive 👍 This allows you to focus on creativity, building, and mastering obby challenges without unnecessary complexity.

Progression and Development
Progression in Obby: Build a Rollercoaster is based on steady expansion and improvement 🔧 As you ride your tracks and develop your builds, you unlock new track pieces, construction elements, and design options. Each upgrade gives you more freedom to build longer, faster, and more dynamic roller coaster rides.

Over time, your roller coasters grow from small tracks into large and impressive constructions filled with turns, drops, and obby challenges 🏗 You are encouraged to refine your designs, rebuild sections, and experiment with new layouts to create smoother and more exciting rides.

Creative Challenge
Each roller coaster is your own creative challenge 🧠 How long can your track be? How smooth can the ride feel? How creative can your layout become? There are no fixed solutions, and every build reflects your design skills and imagination.

The combination of building, testing, and improving creates a satisfying gameplay loop that rewards creativity and experimentation.

Atmosphere and Style
The game features a bright and clean visual style with block-based graphics inspired by Roblox-like games 🎨 The colorful environment and simple shapes keep the focus on building and riding. The atmosphere is light and enjoyable, making the game suitable for both quick sessions and long creative play.

Key Features
• Build and design your own roller coaster tracks
• Create, connect, and expand your coaster rides
• Ride and test every track you build 🎢
• Earn currency by completing rides and obby challenges 💰
• Unlock new track pieces and building elements
• Simple controls and smooth gameplay
• Endless creative building possibilities
• Obby-style gameplay in a Roblox-inspired world

● Plan Ahead: Every level has a limited number of moves, so smart decisions are the key to victory.

data.name: Legend of icarus
data.description_full:
LEGEND OF ICARUS: SHATTER LIMITS, CLAIM THE THRONE!
The era of holy wars on the barren ground has officially come to an end! The eternal veil of clouds that sealed the continent for a millennium has finally shattered. ICARUS – the blood-soaked arena proudly floating amidst the highest clouds – is descending.

Over two decades have passed, but the fiery fragments of those memories have never faded. The smoke and fire of the Crimson Citadel, the agonizing screams in the Demon Square, or the blinding "Ding" sound of a Gem of Blessing dropping on the screen... all the original essence of classic MMORPG youth is now perfectly reborn on Mobile. Drain your mana, raise your glorious wings, and don your shining armor. The pinnacle of absolute power now eternally belongs to the sky!

1. SEVEN AWAKENED LEGENDS - PERFECT BALANCE
The ultimate convergence of 7 legendary lords, preserving the authentic stat-building paths and classic combat roles:

Dragon Warrior: Vanguard the frontline with devastating combo strikes that tear through space, boasting massive health and unparalleled survival capabilities.

Grand Sorcerer: Master of magic with legendary AoE spells, unleashing massive destruction and lightning-fast teleportation.

Sylvan Elf: Ranged assassin with deadly ice arrows, the soul of every party with the ability to buff attack and defense beyond limits.

Mystic Blade: The one with two great bloodlines, a perfect fusion of melee swordsmanship and forbidden magical arts.

Sovereign Emperor: The proud ruler marching to war with his majestic raven and steed, possessing dark flames to clear all who block his path.

Soul Weaver: The space manipulator carrying books of eternal curses, draining the life force of enemies.

Astral Brawler: The furious iron fist that breaks all magical conventions, delivering shockwave punches that shake the mortal realm.

2. ICARUS MAP - THE SANCTUARY OF WINGS
Unlock the limits of gravity! For the first time, experience mid-air combat recreated in extreme sharpness. Tame the Sky Drake, equip your sparkling majestic wings to step into the most brutal battlefield. Face the phantom legions, dodge the ash storms, and summon your Guild brothers to hunt the evil god Crimson Phoenix to seize the priceless Celestial Feather.

3. IMMORTAL MEMORIES - RELIVE CLASSIC EVENTS
Forget boring routines, awaken the instincts of a true hardcore grinder with a series of thrilling dungeons:

Crimson Citadel: Equip the Invisibility Cloak, charge across the blood-soaked narrow bridge, smash the Crystal, and seize the Divine Weapon before time runs out.

Demon Square: A hell with no escape! Unleash full-screen skills amidst a dense sea of monsters to claim the throne of survival.

Fortress of Chaos: The most primal Battle Royale arena! Everyone shares the same appearance, no brothers, no alliances. Knock enemies into the abyss to become the sole survivor.

4. DAILY NOSTALGIA - UNFORGETTABLE FIELD HUNTS
Not just dungeons, the open world comes alive with random field events that push emotions to the peak:

Hear the horn signaling the Pale Sorcerer's invasion, grab your weapon, and hunt through every coordinate.

Relive sleepless nights AFK hunting the Lunar Rabbit hiding in the grassy plains.

The ultimate thrill of smashing Phantom Lanterns in the cold misty night, hoping for the legendary "Ding" of a jewel drop.

The dark continent is too cramped for ambitions of kingship. The bloodiest gates of heaven in history have officially unsealed!

To all brothers! Are you ready to dye these clouds red? Raise your weapons, download the game today, and write your own immortal epic!

data.name: Dont let it grow
data.description_full:
THEY KEEP GROWING. CAN YOU STOP THEM?
Welcome to Don't Let It Grow, the ultimate high-octane arcade shooter where your survival depends on one thing: Extreme Firepower. Vicious, snake-like virus chains are descending from above, and every second they survive, they get more dangerous. Your mission is simple: slide your defender, aim true, and blast those numbers down to zero.

STAY FAST. SHOOT FASTER.
The faster you shoot, the higher your damage. In this game, speed isn't just a bonus—it's your only lifeline. Upgrade your fire rate to turn your single shots into a devastating storm of bullets!

CORE FEATURES
⚡ High-Speed Bullet Action: Experience the thrill of "mowing down" massive swarms. The more you shoot, the faster the numbers drop!

🐍 Dynamic Snake Mechanics: Battle unique enemies that move like snakes. Each segment has its own health—break the chain to survive!

🛠️ Evolution & Upgrades: Collect rewards to boost your attack speed and bullet power. Transform your basic pea-shooter into a legendary Gatling gun.

🎯 Precision Sliding: Smooth, one-finger controls allow you to weave through the gaps while maintaining a constant stream of fire.

💥 Satisfying Destruction: Nothing feels better than watching a massive "10,000" health segment crumble into dust under your barrage.

🌍 Endless Challenges: Tackle increasingly difficult waves with "Easy," "Normal," and "Hell" modes. How long can you hold the line?

HOW TO PLAY
Slide to Move: Drag your finger left and right to position your defender.

Aim for the Numbers: Target the segments with the lowest numbers to create a path, or focus on the head to stop the lead.

Prioritize Speed: Always look for power-ups that increase your Fire Rate. In Don't Let It Grow, speed is your best defense!

Don't Get Crushed: If the snake reaches the bottom line, it’s game over!

The swarm is evolving. The numbers are rising. Download "Don't Let It Grow" now and show them who owns the screen!

data.name: Theme Association: Sort Puzzle
data.description_full:
Theme Association: Sort Puzzle is a relaxing puzzle game that challenges your brain to recognize patterns, discover connections, and organize objects into meaningful groups.

In every level, you are presented with a collection of items that belong to different categories. Your goal is to study each object carefully and place it with others that share the same category. Some puzzles are simple, while others require deeper thinking to identify the correct relationships.

Unlike traditional sorting games that focus only on colors or shapes, Theme Association encourages players to think conceptually. The challenge comes from recognizing how objects relate to one another and understanding the category they belong to.

This unique puzzle mechanic turns each level into a small logic challenge. You must analyze the objects, eliminate incorrect matches, and gradually organize everything into clear categories.

The gameplay is designed to be relaxing and enjoyable for players of all skill levels. Simple controls allow you to move objects easily, while the gradually increasing puzzle complexity keeps the game engaging.

As you progress, new puzzles introduce more objects, more categories, and more interesting combinations. This keeps the experience fresh while providing a steady sense of improvement and mastery.

One of the most satisfying aspects of Theme Association is the moment when a puzzle finally becomes clear. What first appears as a random collection of items slowly reveals its hidden structure as you begin to organize everything correctly.

The clean visual design helps players focus on the puzzle itself. Bright icons, simple layouts, and smooth interactions make every level easy to understand and enjoyable to solve.

Theme Association is perfect for players who enjoy brain training games, relaxing puzzles, and thoughtful challenges that reward observation and logical thinking.

Whether you want to exercise your mind for a few minutes or relax with a longer puzzle session, Theme Association offers a calm and satisfying experience.

Key Features of Theme Association: Sort Puzzle

• Category based puzzle gameplay
• Discover connections between objects
• Organize items into logical categories
• Relaxing brain puzzles with no time limits
• Simple controls and clear visuals
• Increasing challenge across many levels
• Perfect for casual puzzle players
• Designed for relaxing and thoughtful gameplay

Train your brain, sharpen your observation skills, and enjoy the satisfaction of solving clever puzzles.

Download Theme Association: Sort Puzzle and experience a new kind of relaxing logic puzzle.

data.name: 青丘世界：緣起
data.description_full:
下一次遇見，在青丘世界。
2026 年旗艦級 3D 仙俠大作《青丘世界：緣起》，以超高精度建模與動態光影系統，重構東方仙俠的浪漫與壯闊。
你將化身守令一脈的末代弟子，執掌殘缺的御妖令。朱雀精魄蠢動，上古封印將破——斬妖除魔之外，更要揭開塗山氏一族世代守護的禁忌真相。諸神不臨，仙妖對峙，你的每一次選擇，都將改寫這場劫數的終局。
踏入青丘，一草一木皆靈韻，一顰一笑盡風華，在仙霧縈繞的山海間，展開屬於你的緣起之旅。

【四大職業・各具其風采】
靈狐、劍仙、逐月、龍槍——四大職業各擁獨特的戰鬥美學。
每個宗門皆配備專屬技能與覺醒造型，並可自由搭配祕法絕技，讓你創造屬於自己的仙俠風骨。

【遇見青丘・尋覓大世界】
這是一個兼具絕美風景與溫暖人情的開放仙界。你將與好友一同御劍乘風、踏雲尋蹤，一步一景，處處驚鴻，在湖邊共許願，在秘境中探險。
告別單機式修仙，讓每一次相遇，都成為牽絆的開端。

【靈韻天成 · 一顏一世界】
高自由度捏臉系統，從眉眼輪廓、衣飾妝容皆由你親手定製。從清冷仙君到嬌萌靈狐，你所思念的模樣，從此躍然於指尖。
一顏一鏡，照見獨一無二的你。

【百妖通靈・掌馭由汝心】
遊戲內藏匿著形形色色的妖靈——或憨態可掬，或威風凜凜，各具性情。你將邂逅、馴化並與牠們共生，結下獨一無二的羈絆。
每一隻妖靈皆擁有獨立的養成與進化路線，你將攜同心愛的妖靈並肩作戰，縱橫仙魔戰場。

【霓裳玉羽・纖毫畢現之美】
極致畫質，為每一件時裝賦予靈魂。綢緞的流動、輕紗的透光、金屬的冷冽、羽翼的豐盈——材質細膩到每一縷絲線。
數千款時裝配件自由搭配，更支援百萬種自由染色，隨心搭配，告別撞衫。在青丘世界，你可以比世界更多彩。

【繁花為禮・情深到家】
遊戲內外，好禮相連。在預約活動頁參與「繁花大賽」活動，或與心上人在遊戲中結成情緣，即可額外獲得真實鮮花豪禮——百萬鮮花宅配到家，讓浪漫從虛實之間綻放於眼前。

※ 本軟體因涉及暴力、戀愛交友 、性（遊戲角色穿著凸顯性特徵之服飾），依遊戲軟體分級管理辦法分類為輔12級。
※ 本遊戲為免費使用，遊戲內另提供購買虛擬遊戲幣、物品等付費服務。
※ 長時間進行遊戲，請注意使用時間，避免沉迷於遊戲。

At first the puzzles seem straightforward, but the wooden maze quickly becomes more complex. Arrows block each other, paths twist and overlap, and one wrong move can leave you stuck. Finding the right sequence requires observation, patience, and smart planning.
Every solved puzzle creates a satisfying chain of movement as the arrows slide away and the board clears step by step. Watching the path open and the maze unravel is both relaxing and rewarding.
The warm wooden visuals create a calm atmosphere that makes every puzzle enjoyable to explore. Smooth animations and simple tap controls keep the gameplay intuitive while the challenges gradually grow more intricate.
As you progress, you’ll encounter new maze layouts, tighter spaces, and more complicated arrow arrangements that test your logic and puzzle-solving skills. Each level is designed to be easy to understand but challenging to master.
Whether you enjoy relaxing brain teasers, maze puzzles, or satisfying logic games, Wooden Escape offers a peaceful yet engaging experience that keeps your mind active while remaining easy to play anytime.

Follow the arrows carefully.

data.name: Five Nights at Freddy's Fnaf
data.description_full:
No longer trapped in the pizzeria—they’re inside your house
You thought you left the nightmare behind when you quit your job as a security guard. You were wrong. The animatronic monsters have found where you live, and now the ultimate survival horror challenge begins in your own bedroom.

In Five Nights at Freddy's Fnaf, the rules have changed. There are no security cameras to hide behind and no power grid to manage. You only have your senses, a flickering flashlight, and your instincts.

CAN YOU SURVIVE?
The hallway is quiet... too quiet. Use your ears to listen for breathing at the doors. If you hear something, shut the door immediately! If the coast is clear, use your flashlight to scare away the creatures lurking in the shadows. But be careful—if you flash your light while they are at the door, it’s game over.

GAME FEATURES:

Immersive Home Horror – Experience a terrifying “home invasion” atmosphere where nowhere feels safe—not the closet, not the bed, and definitely not the hallway.

Sound-Based Gameplay – This is a game of high-tension listening. Use headphones to hear the mechanical footsteps and sinister breathing of the nightmare animatronics.

Hidden Lore – Collect secret items around the house to piece together the story of why these machines are hunting you specifically.

The Closet & The Bed – They aren’t just coming from the doors. Check behind you and keep an eye on the closet. Something is hiding in the plushies.

Five Nights at Freddy's Fnaf brings the legendary jump-scare mechanics to a domestic setting. It’s a test of nerves, timing, and courage for fans of Freddy’s House, FNAF and animatronic survival horror.
data.description_short: Feel the fear in an ultimate Fnaf security breach augmented horror nightmare!

data.name: Тайны города - Merge
data.description_full:
Любите интересные игры без интернета в жанре merge? Слияние предметов увлекает и помогает разгрузить мозг?
Тайны города — это не просто merge игра, это настоящее приключение, которые помогает скрасить серые будни тем, кто любит соединять предметы в игре.
Как играть?
Соединяйте предметы, открывайте новые локации, помогайте героям справляться с трудностями.
Помимо мерж механики в игре важную роль занимает сюжет. Знакомьтесь: Алекс и Эмма. Мать и дочь, которым пришлось начать всё с нуля.
После предательства мужа девушка собирает вещи и вместе с дочерью возвращается на старую семейную ферму. Она надеется на тихую жизнь, но реальность оказывается куда суровее: вместо покоя — горы долгов, а вместо поддержки — визиты бывшего мужа и его адвоката, которые хотят отобрать последнее, что у неё осталось. Но Алекс не из тех, кто сдаётся. Ради дочери она готова на всё.
Это история о том, как не сломаться под ударами судьбы, обрести новый дом и найти в себе силы бороться за счастье. Развитие истории, совмещение предметов в merge головоломке.
А ещё в Тайнах города вас ждут:

Climb shelves, crawl under tables, squeeze through vents.

Hide in closets, behind doors, or anywhere dark and quiet.

Bright, colorful 3D graphics make every room feel alive—cluttered living rooms, messy kitchens, shadowy basements full of surprises. Scattered everywhere are glowing mystery cubes ✨. Collect them all and you’ll unlock secret paths, bonus areas, and extra pieces of the story.

data.name: Tomb Busters
data.description_full:
The first co-op horror extraction game on mobile, with full PC cross-play. Squad up, loot cursed ruins, escape alive — and try not to die laughing.

CO-OP HORROR EXTRACTION — NOW ON MOBILE
The horror extraction genre finally comes to your phone, and it's finally fun for everyone. No hardcore grind. No steep learning curve. Go deeper for rarer relics, but push too far and you lose everything.

SCARY ALONE. HILARIOUS TOGETHER.
Solo? Genuinely terrifying. With friends? Pure chaos. Play on mobile or PC with full cross-play — your squad, your platform. Proximity voice chat turns every run into unscripted comedy. Dance in front of the boss. Watch your friend's ridiculous death replay on loop. Panic-scream a warning that comes three seconds too late. Oh, and one of your "teammates" might not be human.

Every creature comes from ancient Eastern supernatural legends — each with its own origin story, skill, and weakness. The Ghost Bride hunts only one player — and only that player can see her. The Puppet copies your teammate's voice to lure you in. Fight them, outsmart them — or capture them alive.

PICK YOUR ROLE. OWN YOUR STYLE.
Choose your character — Explorer, Supporter, Fighter — each with a unique playstyle. Then dress them however you want. Tactical gear, elegant maid outfits, wacky headgear so weird even ghosts step aside. Your role, your look.

EVERY RUN HITS DIFFERENT
Randomized maps, traps, loot, and monster spawns. Dynamic conditions shifts mid-raid — blood moons, dense fog, solar eclipses — each changing how monsters behave. No two runs play the same.

data.name: Warplanes: Task Force
data.description_full:
Take to the skies in Warplanes: Task Force, an action-packed combat flight game set in the modern era. Command a fleet of the world’s most advanced aircraft and engage in intense aerial battles against a wide array of threats, including tactical drones, helicopters, stealth fighters, and ground-based military forces.
Experience a relaxing yet engaging single-player experience designed for military enthusiasts. The game offers two ways to experience the modern battlefield:
● Pilot Mode: Focus purely on the action. Collect, upgrade, and take command of your favorite jets as you complete challenging missions.
● Commander Mode: Adds a strategic twist to the gameplay. Besides piloting your aircraft, you also take responsibility for your unit’s growth. Expand your airbase, manage resources, and recruit a team of elite pilots to ensure your task force is always combat-ready.
Prepare for every sortie by customizing your loadout to match the mission’s objectives—from high-altitude interceptions to precision strikes. Deploy across diverse, neutral environments, from urban landscapes and open seas to sun-scorched deserts and snow-covered mountains.
KEY FEATURES:
● Modern Aviation Icons: Take the stick of a wide range of aircraft, from air-superiority fighters like the F-22 Raptor and F-14 Tomcat to multi-role jets such as the F-16 Viper and Eurofighter Typhoon.
● Strategic Unit Management: In Commander Mode, enhance your experience by building hangars, managing fuel supplies, and training pilots to increase their combat effectiveness.

2. The core objective is character growth and level progression. Players earn coins and materials by clearing levels to upgrade character levels, unlock skills, and enhance equipment, gradually overcoming initial weaknesses to achieve a power comeback. 3. The levels incorporate interactive elements. Some scenes contain destructible obstacles and hidden supply points. Making good use of scene resources can reduce the difficulty of battles, helping you to successfully turn the tide and pass the levels, increasing the fun and strategy of the gameplay.

data.name: Flower Power: Blooming
data.description_full:
1. Game Rules
The core gameplay of Flower Power: The Art of Blooming revolves around matching and clearing tiles with identical patterns. Below the playing field, there is a slot that can hold up to 7 tiles. Clicking on a tile automatically places it into this slot. When 3 tiles with the same pattern are in the slot, they will be instantly cleared.

- Tip: You have a maximum of 7 moves per round to clear three tiles of the same design! If the slot fills up without matching three tiles, you lose. Every move counts!

- Layered Tiles: Some tiles may have multiple layers. Only after removing the top layer can you select and clear the lower layers.

- Winning Condition: Once no tiles remain on the board, you have successfully completed the level!

2. Game Features
Flower Power: The Art of Blooming offers a variety of features designed for players of all skill levels:

1. Easy Start: Begin with straightforward puzzles to help you quickly get the hang of the game. As you progress, the difficulty increases gradually, testing your strategy and problem-solving skills.

data.name: Obelisk: Home Horror Game
data.description_full:
Obelisk: Home Horror Game is an analog horror game and survival horror game inspired by The Obelisk Analog Horror. Enter a distorted home where fear feels personal, the walls feel alive, and every room pulls you deeper into a nightmare shaped by VHS horror, psychological terror, and maze-like dread.

This is not just another scary house. This is home, your hallway, your bedroom door, your familiar rooms twisted into a living trap by analog horror logic. Lights buzz like a dying CRT. Audio bends into a low mechanical hum. Static tears across the screen. The house changes when you are not looking, and somewhere inside it, The Obelisk is watching.

In The Obelisk: Home Horror Game, the core nightmare is simple: escape a place that refuses to let you leave. Rooms connect the wrong way. Corridors loop back with something subtly changed. Doors open into spaces that should not exist. A staircase leads farther down than your house should ever allow. What begins as a familiar environment becomes a cruel, shifting prison of fear.

Fans of The Obelisk Analog Horror, creepypasta horror, VHS horror, and psychological horror games will recognize the oppressive dread of stories like House with No Windows, Why Do You Keep Us Here, The Man in the Tower, and I Made a New Friend. This game turns that feeling into an interactive nightmare where the horror is intimate, distorted, and always close.

This is survival horror without power fantasy. You cannot become a hero. You cannot overpower what hunts you. You cannot fight The Obelisk. Your only tools are observation, timing, silence, and instinct. Listen for movement that does not match your own. Watch for details that shift. Learn the house before it learns you.

If you love analog horror games, scary games, VHS horror aesthetics, and dark exploration inside a cursed house, The Obelisk: Home Horror Game delivers a tense and immersive descent into fear. The deeper you go, the less your home feels like home, and the more it feels like something built to keep you inside forever.

You cannot reason with the house.
You cannot fight The Obelisk.
You can only survive long enough to understand what it wants.

And if you are wrong, the house will keep you.

The Obelisk: Home Horror Game is a terrifying analog horror experience for players who want survival horror, VHS horror, and a nightmare built from familiar spaces turned hostile.

data.name: Arrow Explorer: Escape Puzzle
data.description_full:

🚫Here’s the twist: you may only remove a line if it’s currently free (not blocked). Tap it and it will slide out in its arrow direction. Choosing the wrong line at the wrong time may cost you a chance.

🔁🧠How it works
- Tap only lines that aren’t blocked
- The line slides out along its arrow direction
- You get 3 mistakes before the level ends
- Clear every line to complete the puzzle

⏱️📱🔥What makes it addictive
- Minimal controls, real strategy: it’s all about sequence
- Quick, satisfying clears with a calm, focused vibe
- Great for short breaks—or long “one more try” sessions

💡🏆If you like puzzles that feel relaxing but demand precision, Arrow Explorer is your next obsession.

data.name: Berry Blast Pop
data.description_full:
Berry Blast Pop is a calming, mind-stimulating puzzle game crafted for pure stress relief. Unlike most match-3 titles, there are no harsh timers or ticking countdowns to rush you. Your objective is straightforward: tap any cluster of two or more identically colored blocks to wipe them away. String together bigger combos to rack up huge point totals!
How to Play
1. Tap, Match & Score: Tap any group of connected same-color blocks (either horizontally or vertically) to erase them and gain points with every clear.
2. Go Big for Bigger Rewards: The more blocks you eliminate with a single tap, the higher your combo score climbs—bigger clusters mean massive point boosts!
3. Clear the Grid to Conquer the Level: Each stage ends when no more connected same-color blocks are left on the board. Your final score will decide if you pass the level and unlock the next challenge.
Berry Blast Pop comes packed with countless levels that ramp up in difficulty step by step. To move forward, you’ll need to hit higher score goals as you take on more challenging later stages. Boasting a sleek, minimalist design and focused gameplay—no over-the-top distractions, just simple, deeply satisfying puzzle fun—it’s the ideal way to unwind and make the most of your free time.

Just swipe to move cards around. Once two cards connect, they lock together so you can drag them as one “group”—smooth, effortless, and super satisfying.
-Addictive Chain Snaps
Line up multiple cards and trigger a “snap-snap-snap” chain reaction as they lock in at once. That rush is hard to resist—you’ll always want one more round.

Easy for beginners, rewarding for experts who love optimizing their moves and layout. Great for commutes, quick breaks, or relaxing before bed.

-Swipe to Move Cards
Swipe on the screen to drag cards wherever you want.
-Snap & Move Connected Cards Together
When a card is placed correctly, it “clicks” into position and connects. Connected cards can then be moved as a single group.
-Watch Out for Overlaps & Size Changes
If a smaller card is placed on top of a larger one, the larger card may temporarily shrink. Keep an eye on size changes and combine cards carefully to avoid confusion.

Simple to play, yet surprisingly strategic: plan your layout, avoid blocking key pieces, and set up satisfying chain snaps. If you love jigsaw puzzles, card-style organizing, or just want a relaxing and addictive brain game—give it a try today!

data.name: Башни и Герои: Война Миров
data.description_full:

Ядро игры: бесконечно разнообразная стратегия обороны
Каждая локация — это холст для вашего тактического гения. Огромное количество уникальных карт, от извилистых троп до сложных лабиринтов, от открытых полей до неприступных ущелий — каждая битва ставит новую стратегическую задачу. Классический геймплей башенной защиты выведен на новый уровень: типы башен, комбинации навыков, пути улучшений и распределение ресурсов — каждое ваше решение меняет ход сражения. Испытайте свои пределы в режиме «Испытание Бездны», где бесконечные волны врагов проверят вашу оборону на прочность.

Искусство обороны — это не только защита, но и интеллектуальное противостояние с сильнейшими! От «Полигона Тактики», где проверяются основы, до «Небесного Рейтинга» для элиты и легендарной межсерверной лиги «Война Святилищ» — здесь создана целая экосистема для истинных стратегов. Покажите свой уникальный стиль защиты, изучите тактики лучших игроков мира и станьте мастером башенной обороны в битве стратегий.

Герои и оборона: стройте идеальную защитную систему
Герои — это не просто воины, а ключевые элементы вашей обороны! Легендарные герои открывают эксклюзивные навыки для башен, эпические герои дают уникальные усиления. Получите легендарного командира обороны при входе в игру, открывайте редких мастеров-строителей, проходя уровни. Система синергии между героями и башнями меняет правила игры: маг огня усиливает огненные башни, паладин даёт щиты, ассасин усиливает ловушки. Создайте свою непобедимую комбинацию!

Умный прогресс: наслаждайтесь сутью тактики
Мы вернулись к истокам жанра — радость стратегии не должна тонуть в рутине. Уникальная система офлайн-развития позволяет вашей обороне совершенствоваться постоянно. Никакого монотонного гринда и обязательных входов в игру. Каждая ваша сессия — это новые тактические вызовы. Ваше время посвящено только оптимизации построек, изучению тактик и соревновательным боям — чистому и глубокому искусству башенной обороны.

«Башни и Герои: Война Миров» — Здесь нет места простому накоплению силы, только продуманным построениям. Здесь нет побед через превосходство в статистиках, только через интеллектуальное превосходство. Присоединяйтесь и станьте архитектором победы!

data.name: Horror Shawarma & Patience
data.description_full:
Horror Shawarma & Patience is a scary horror simulator where an ordinary job at a shawarma kiosk slowly turns into a disturbing psychological nightmare.

DAY — SHAWARMA KIOSK

By day, you are just a simple worker in a small shawarma kiosk.
You cook tasty shawarma, take orders, keep the place clean, throw out the trash, and try to grow your tiny business.
It’s a normal workday — just like millions of other workers live every day.

Many customers pass through your kiosk.
Some of them feel too strange, others are openly unsettling.
Someone stares for too long. Someone says inappropriate things.
Some customers come back again and again, smiling in a way that feels wrong.
What if they’re not even human?

But you endure it.
That’s work.
You need patience.
Nothing scary… right?

NIGHT — HORROR AND INSOMNIA

When the kiosk closes, a completely different game begins.

At night, the work simulator turns into true domestic psychological horror.
You can’t sleep. Strange sounds echo through your apartment. Shadows move.
Unsettling visions follow you from room to room.

You keep doing everyday things — cooking food, cleaning, trying to relax —
but fear slowly crawls into your mind.
Your patience starts to fade, and it feels like you’re losing your grip on reality.

DON’T WATCH TOO LONG

You decide to face the fear and understand what’s happening.
You walk to the window and grab your binoculars.
Lights are on in the building across the street.
Clearly, you’re not the only one awake tonight.

Your patience — is running out, and you start watching your neighbors.
First out of curiosity.
Then out of anxiety.

But don’t watch for too long.
What begins as patience can turn into obsession —
and obsession can turn into a real nightmare.

The longer you look, the scarier it becomes.
Ordinary scenes twist into something horrifying.
And the feeling that someone is watching you back never goes away.

How do you survive until morning
just to return to another shift at the shawarma kiosk?

GAME FEATURES
- Shawarma kiosk work simulator
- Strange and terrifying visitors
- Psychological horror and everyday fear
- Watching mechanics and growing paranoia
- Atmosphere of anxiety, exhaustion, and insomnia
- Slow transformation of routine into a nightmare
- A constant test of your terpenie and sanity

This is a game about work, watching, and consequences.
About patience that slowly breaks.
About a nightmare that begins when you think everything is under control.

Download Horror Shawarma & Patience and try to survive the night.

data.name: Minicraft: Craftarena Block 3D
data.description_full:
Minicraft - Block Craftarena is a highly popular sandbox game that immerses players in an expansive, pixelated world filled with creativity, exploration, and survival. Here's a breakdown of its key features:

1. Endless Exploration:
Minicraft Block Craftarena 3D offers a vast block 3D OpenWorld gameplay, procedurally generated world to discover. From lush forests and towering mountain ranges to expansive oceans and deep caves, there’s no shortage of new areas to explore.

2. Boundless Creativity:
With its signature block-based building system, players have the freedom to create anything from complex structures and stunning landscapes to functional redstone devices, all limited only by their imagination.

3. Creative Mode:
For those who prefer an unrestricted experience, Creative mode provides infinite resources and the ability to fly, letting players build grand creations without worrying about resource gathering or dangerous mobs.

4. Mining and Crafting:
The heart of the gameplay revolves around mining resources like ores and minerals to craft useful items, tools, and weapons. The crafting system is straightforward, allowing players to combine items in a crafting grid.

5. Redstone Engineering:
Redstone, a special resource, allows players to design complex machinery, circuits, and automated systems. From simple traps to elaborate devices, redstone engineering introduces a technical side to the game.

6. Survival Mode:
In Survival mode, players must gather resources, craft essential tools, and defend themselves from hostile mobs. The changing day and night cycles introduce new challenges, with nighttime bringing more dangerous enemies.

7. Multiplayer Features:
Craftarena’s multiplayer mode enables players to collaborate or compete with friends and other players. Whether building together or engaging in player-versus-player combat, it adds a social and competitive element to the game.

8. Enchanting and Brewing:
As players advance, they can enchant weapons and tools to give them special abilities, or brew potions to improve their survival. These deeper mechanics add long-term goals and variety to gameplay.

9. Biomes and Dimensions:
The game world is divided into several biomes, each with unique climates, vegetation, and terrain. Players can also venture into mystical dimensions like the Nether and the End, where they’ll face new challenges and reap rich rewards.

10. Mobs and Creatures:
Craftarena’s world is filled with a range of creatures, from the infamous Creeper to Endermen and more. Each mob introduces unique challenges, requiring players to adjust their strategies and tactics to survive.

In summary, the allure of Minicraft Block Craftarena 3D lies in its combination of open-ended creativity, survival challenges, exploration, and a thriving multiplayer community. Whether you're playing solo or with friends, the possibilities in this vast, blocky world are truly endless.

data.name: Minicraft: Block Craft 3D
data.description_full:
Welcome to Minicraft: Block Craft 3D!

Minicraft: Block Craft 3D is a professional sandbox adventure game that allows players to explore a vast block-based world filled with creativity, survival challenges, and endless possibilities. It is designed for players who enjoy crafting, building, and discovering new environments.

1. Open World Exploration
The game features a large, procedurally generated open world where every area feels unique. Players can explore forests, mountains, caves, deserts, and oceans, making each journey exciting and unpredictable.

2. Creative Building System
With its flexible block-based building system, players can construct anything they imagine. From simple houses to massive cities and detailed structures, creativity has no limits.

3. Survival Mode Challenges
In Survival mode, players must collect resources, craft tools, and defend themselves against hostile creatures. The day and night cycle increases difficulty, as enemies become more dangerous after sunset.

4. Creative Mode Freedom
Creative mode provides unlimited resources and the ability to fly. This mode is perfect for players who want to focus entirely on building and design without survival restrictions.

5. Mining and Crafting Mechanics
Mining plays a central role in the game. Players gather ores and materials to craft tools, weapons, armor, and other useful items using an easy-to-learn crafting system.

6. Enchanting and Brewing Systems
As players progress, they can unlock enchanting and potion brewing features. These systems enhance tools and equipment with special abilities, improving survival and exploration.

7. Mobs and Creatures
The world is filled with a variety of mobs, each with unique behaviors and challenges. Players must adjust their strategies to survive encounters with different creatures.

8. Biomes and Special Dimensions
Multiple biomes offer diverse landscapes, climates, and resources. Special dimensions introduce rare items, tougher enemies, and exciting new adventures.

9. Redstone Engineering
The redstone system allows players to create automated machines, traps, and mechanisms. From basic switches to advanced circuits, it adds depth and creativity to gameplay.

10. Multiplayer Experience
Multiplayer mode enables players to connect, collaborate, or compete with others. Build together, explore new areas, or engage in PvP battles for a more social gaming experience.

In essence, Minicraft: Block Craft 3D stands out through its perfect balance of creative freedom, open-world exploration, and engaging survival challenges. Supported by an active and growing community, the game continues to evolve with new possibilities. Whether you choose to play alone or team up with friends, the blocky world offers endless opportunities for fun and imagination.

선 그리기 및 저장
손가락으로 선을 그려 즉시 방어벽을 만들고 귀여운 강아지들을 몬스터의 공격으로부터 보호하세요. 각 레벨마다 날아다니는 박쥐부터 굴러오는 바위까지 새로운 도전이 기다리고 있습니다. 과연 당신은 최고의 강아지 영웅이 될 수 있을까요?

건설 및 방어
종말의 한복판에 요새를 건설하세요. 견고한 성벽을 쌓고, 필수 자원 기지를 설치하고, 첨단 기술을 개발하여 끊임없이 몰려오는 언데드 무리를 막아내세요. 당신이 짓는 모든 건물과 강화하는 모든 방어 시설은 생존과 멸망을 가르는 중요한 요소가 될 것입니다.

관리 및 적응
각기 다른 기술, 특성, 그리고 어려움을 지닌 생존자 공동체를 이끌어 나가세요. 역할을 분담하고, 사기를 관리하고, 생사를 가르는 결정을 내려 당신의 안식처를 지켜내세요. 하지만 조심하세요. 이 파괴된 세상에서 위험은 외부에서만 오는 것이 아닙니다.

탐험과 탈환
옛 세계의 폐허 속으로 탐험대를 보내세요. 보급품을 찾고, 숨겨진 역사를 밝혀내고, 다른 생존자들을 만나세요. 어떤 이들은 기꺼이 도움을 주려 하고, 어떤 이들은 배신하려 들 것입니다. 영향력을 확장하고, 잃어버린 영토를 되찾고, 대재앙의 배후에 숨겨진 어두운 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

동맹과 지배
전 세계 플레이어들과 동맹을 맺으세요. 공격을 조율하고, 자원을 공유하고, 힘을 합쳐 좀비 무리와 적대 세력을 물리치세요. 함께라면 단순한 피난처가 아닌, 새로운 문명을 건설할 수 있습니다.

세상의 종말은 단지 시작일 뿐입니다. 당신은 그저 살아남을 것인가… 아니면 인류를 새로운 시대로 이끌 것인가?

data.name: NTE: Neverness to Everness
data.description_full:
NTE is a supernatural open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. The story begins in the city of Hethereau, where you play as its first "unlicensed" Anomaly Hunter. You'll join the crew at Eibon, a rundown antique shop that keeps the lights on by taking Anomaly commissions from anyone willing to pay. Alongside a diverse cast of extraordinary companions, you'll unravel urban mysteries, ride out adventures full of laughs and heartbreak, and write your own stories in the neon-lit streets.

◆ Strange City, Strange Adventures

Welcome to the first stop in your appraisal career—Hethereau, a sprawling and vibrant metropolis!

In the crowded halls of the Bureau of Anomaly Control, hopeful Oddities queue up for resident permits, while over at the train station, an Esper commuter snaps his fingers to clean his work suit on the fly. Down one block, a chaotic chase after Danzaburou is spiraling out of control; while across the street, a vacationing silver-gloved Butler is shooting the breeze with the owner of a second-hand electronics shop. Everywhere you look, there's no shortage of intriguingly "abnormal" scenes.

Want to dive deeper into a world where humans and the supernatural coexist? Start your journey in Hethereau to see it for yourself. The lively and quirky daily life here is a grand adventure in itself.

◆ Interesting Stories, Lighthearted Connections

Today's Top Story: Rumors are swirling about a mysterious pawnshop that only appears on the night of the full moon. What would you trade for a wish?

Breaking News: Taygedo's romance crisis! Romance and impulse, heartbreak and missed chances—Miss Tako, the object of a secret crush, is about to leave Hethereau with her guarantor. How will the lovestruck otter get his feelings across before it's too late?

Reliable Insider Tip: Film Orbit Studio is back in business! Members of the Eibon Antique Shop get exclusive discounts!

Weather Update: The Anomaly Rainman is entering an active phase—don't forget your rain gear on the way out!

That wraps up today's 10AM broadcast. Stay tuned for mysterious Anomalies, unbreakable "Oaths," and the ever-growing shadow of the colossal "Circle" organization, looming larger in the fragmented echoes of "Prophecies"...

◆ Encounters and Bonds

Explore hidden shops tucked away in back alleys and meet their enigmatic owners, along with absurdly overpowered bodyguards, "jack-of-all-trades" robotic butlers, troublemakers who can't help finding problems, and TV-headed repairmen with some very curious eating habits.

As part of the Eibon crew, you'll never be short on energetic companions for the road ahead.

Expand your social circle starting from the bustling Hankaku Street! Meet members from different factions and add them as "Bagel" friends!

From the tight-knit neighborhood of street shops to the city's unique hunter organizations, countless side stories await—ready for you to make friends and forge bonds across every corner of Hethereau.

◆ Customize Your Urban Lifestyle

Explore the city on your own terms—stick to familiar routines or shake things up.

Customize your ride and tear through the city streets, or hop on the Ghost Train to cut through Anomaly space and arrive in a flash.

In your downtime, swing by the old shops on Hankaku Street to browse their secret seasonal stock, or buy a cozy little home and deck it out to your liking.

Go at your own pace, follow your instincts, and let Hethereau reward you with colorful days worth remembering.

data.name: Jelly Busters: Puzzle Game
data.description_full:
Drop into the smoothest skatepark in town with the Jelly Busters crew, a squad of bouncy jellies who live to skate, color shoot, and bust their way through walls of cubes. Every run starts with a simple push on your board, a quick aim, and a clean shot as you send your jelly flying into a glowing, colorful puzzle blast of cubes hiding a secret picture and image below.

Jelly Busters adds a fun, skate-infused twist packed with ASMR pleasure and arcade-style thrills. With every tap, you shoot into stacks of colors, bust the cubes, and slowly keep busting the image underneath until the whole board is clear.

The sound and feel are tuned for maximum satisfying chill. Cubes crumble with soft pops, jellies bounce just right, and the whole game wraps you in a relaxing mood that still demands fast reaction and strategic thinking. data.name: I Am Prankster Cat
